47void *pulserthread(void *arg)
48{
49 (void)arg;
50 struct timeval now, then;
51 register int i, j, k;
52
53#ifdef HAVE_SYS_IO
54 if (haspp == 2) {
55 ioperm(pbase, 2, 1);
56 }
57#endif
58 stoppulser = 0;
59 pp_lastmask = 0;
60 ast_mutex_lock(&pp_lock);
61 ast_radio_ppwrite(haspp, ppfd, pbase, pport, pp_val);
62 ast_mutex_unlock(&pp_lock);
63 then = ast_radio_tvnow();
64
65 while (!stoppulser) {
66 usleep(50000);
67 ast_mutex_lock(&pp_lock);
68 now = ast_radio_tvnow();
69 j = ast_tvdiff_ms(now, then);
70 then = now;
71 pp_lastmask = pp_pulsemask;
72 pp_pulsemask = 0;
73 for (i = 2; i <= 9; i++) {
74 k = pp_pulsetimer[i];
75 if (k) {
76 k -= j;
77 if (k < 0) {
78 k = 0;
79 }
80 pp_pulsetimer[i] = k;
81 }
82 if (k) {
83 pp_pulsemask |= 1 << (i - 2);
84 }
85 }
86 if (pp_pulsemask != pp_lastmask) {
87 pp_val ^= pp_lastmask ^ pp_pulsemask;
88 ast_radio_ppwrite(haspp, ppfd, pbase, pport, pp_val);
89 }
90 ast_mutex_unlock(&pp_lock);
91 }
92 return NULL;
93}

112int hidhdwconfig(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
113{
114 int i;
115
116 /* NOTE: on the CM-108AH, GPIO2 is *not* a REAL GPIO.. it was re-purposed
117 * as a signal called "HOOK" which can only be read from the HID.
118 * Apparently, in a REAL CM-108, GPIO really works as a GPIO
119 */
120
121 if (o->hdwtype == 1) {
122 /* sphusb */
123 o->hid_gpio_ctl = 0x08; /* set GPIO4 to output mode */
124 o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc = 2; /* For CTL of GPIO */
125 o->hid_io_cor = 4; /* GPIO3 is COR */
126 o->hid_io_cor_loc = 1; /* GPIO3 is COR */
127 o->hid_io_ctcss = 2; /* GPIO 2 is External CTCSS */
128 o->hid_io_ctcss_loc = 1; /* is GPIO 2 */
129 o->hid_io_ptt = 8; /* GPIO 4 is PTT */
130 o->hid_gpio_loc = 1; /* For ALL GPIO */
131 o->valid_gpios = 1; /* for GPIO 1 */
132 } else if (o->hdwtype == 0) {
133 /* dudeusb */
134 o->hid_gpio_ctl = 0x04; /* set GPIO 3 to output mode */
135 o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc = 2; /* For CTL of GPIO */
136 o->hid_io_cor = 2; /* VOLD DN is COR */
137 o->hid_io_cor_loc = 0; /* VOL DN COR */
138 o->hid_io_ctcss = 1; /* VOL UP External CTCSS */
139 o->hid_io_ctcss_loc = 0; /* VOL UP External CTCSS */
140 o->hid_io_ptt = 4; /* GPIO 3 is PTT */
141 o->hid_gpio_loc = 1; /* For ALL GPIO */
142 o->valid_gpios = 0xfb; /* for GPIO 1,2,4,5,6,7,8 (5,6,7,8 for CM-119 only) */
143 } else if (o->hdwtype == 2) {
144 /* NHRC (N1KDO) (dudeusb w/o user GPIO) */
145 o->hid_gpio_ctl = 0x04; /* set GPIO 3 to output mode */
146 o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc = 2; /* For CTL of GPIO */
147 o->hid_io_cor = 2; /* VOLD DN is COR */
148 o->hid_io_cor_loc = 0; /* VOL DN COR */
149 o->hid_io_ctcss = 1; /* VOL UP is External CTCSS */
150 o->hid_io_ctcss_loc = 0; /* VOL UP CTCSS */
151 o->hid_io_ptt = 4; /* GPIO 3 is PTT */
152 o->hid_gpio_loc = 1; /* For ALL GPIO */
153 o->valid_gpios = 0; /* for GPIO 1,2,4 */
154 } else if (o->hdwtype == 3) {
155 /* custom version */
156 o->hid_gpio_ctl = 0x0c; /* set GPIO 3 & 4 to output mode */
157 o->hid_gpio_ctl_loc = 2; /* For CTL of GPIO */
158 o->hid_io_cor = 2; /* VOLD DN is COR */
159 o->hid_io_cor_loc = 0; /* VOL DN COR */
160 o->hid_io_ctcss = 2; /* GPIO 2 is External CTCSS */
161 o->hid_io_ctcss_loc = 1; /* is GPIO 2 */
162 o->hid_io_ptt = 4; /* GPIO 3 is PTT */
163 o->hid_gpio_loc = 1; /* For ALL GPIO */
164 o->valid_gpios = 1; /* for GPIO 1 */
165 }
166 /* validate clipledgpio setting (Clip LED GPIO#) */
167 if (o->clipledgpio) {
168 if (o->clipledgpio >= GPIO_PINCOUNT ||
169 !(o->valid_gpios & (1 << (o->clipledgpio - 1)))) {
170 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: clipledgpio = GPIO%d not supported\n",
171 o->name, o->clipledgpio);
172 o->clipledgpio = 0;
173 } else {
174 o->hid_gpio_ctl |= 1 << (o->clipledgpio -
175 1); /* confirm Clip LED GPIO set to output mode */
176 }
177 }
178 o->hid_gpio_val = 0;
179 for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PINCOUNT; i++) {
180 /* skip if this one not specified */
181 if (!o->gpios[i]) {
182 continue;
183 }
184 /* skip if not out */
185 if (strncasecmp(o->gpios[i], "out", 3)) {
186 continue;
187 }
188 /* skip if PTT */
189 if ((1 << i) & o->hid_io_ptt) {
190 ast_log(LOG_ERROR,
191 "Channel %s: You can't specify gpio%d, since its the PTT.\n",
192 o->name, i + 1);
193 continue;
194 }
195 /* skip if not a valid GPIO */
196 if (!(o->valid_gpios & (1 << i))) {
197 ast_log(LOG_ERROR,
198 "Channel %s: You can't specify gpio%d, it is not valid in this "
199 "configuration.\n",
200 o->name, i + 1);
201 continue;
202 }
203 o->hid_gpio_ctl |= (1 << i); /* set this one to output, also */
204 /* if default value is 1, set it */
205 if (!strcasecmp(o->gpios[i], "out1")) {
206 o->hid_gpio_val |= (1 << i);
207 }
208 }
209 if (o->invertptt) {
210 o->hid_gpio_val |= o->hid_io_ptt;
211 }
212 return 0;
213}

215void kickptt(const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
216{
217 char c = 0;
218 int res;
219
220 if (!o) {
221 return;
222 }
223 if (o->pttkick[1] == -1) {
224 return;
225 }
226 res = write(o->pttkick[1], &c, 1);
227 if (res <= 0) {
228 /* A wake is advisory; the hardware worker observes the atomic request on
229 * its regular poll. A full nonblocking pipe must not create log noise. */
230 if (errno == EAGAIN
231#if EWOULDBLOCK != EAGAIN
232 || errno == EWOULDBLOCK
233#endif
234 )
235 return;
236 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Channel %s: Write failed: %s\n", o->name, strerror(errno));
237 }
238}

271void usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_prepare(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
272{
273 const struct usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold *hold;
274
275 if (!channel || !channel->radio)
276 return;
277 hold = &channel->plus_tx_playout_hold;
278 /* The previous callback may have made txPttOut high solely to drain the
279 * audio device. Restore the engine's unmodified output before it advances. */
280 if (hold->draining)
281 channel->radio->txPttOut = hold->engine_ptt_out;
282}
283
284void usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_apply(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
285{
286 struct usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold *hold;
287 int input_keyed;
288 int was_draining;
289
290 if (!channel || !channel->radio)
291 return;
292 hold = &channel->plus_tx_playout_hold;
293 was_draining = hold->draining;
294 input_keyed = !!channel->radio->txPttIn;
295 /* A new external key request supersedes queued audio from the previous
296 * transmission. It must never inherit a stale post-playout release timer. */
297 if (input_keyed && !hold->input_keyed) {
298 hold->callbacks_remaining = 0U;
299 hold->draining = 0;
300 }
301 hold->input_keyed = input_keyed;
302 /* Capture the real signaling decision before applying a virtual drain PTT.
303 * This preserves existing CTCSS/DCS tail handling and rekey semantics. */
304 hold->engine_ptt_out = !!channel->radio->txPttOut;
305 if (hold->engine_ptt_out) {
306 hold->draining = 0;
307 return;
308 }
309 if (hold->callbacks_remaining) {
310 channel->radio->txPttOut = 1;
311 hold->draining = 1;
312 } else {
313 channel->radio->txPttOut = 0;
314 hold->draining = 0;
315 /* The signaling engine started its RX blanking interval when it first
316 * requested unkey. Start it again at the actual physical-release point. */
317 if (was_draining)
318 channel->radio->txrxblankingtimer = channel->radio->txrxblankingtime;
319 }
320}

322void usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_publish(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
323{
324 struct usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold *hold;
325
326 if (!channel || !channel->radio)
327 return;
328 hold = &channel->plus_tx_playout_hold;
329 /* The virtual PTT keeps the transmitter keyed only while already accepted
330 * PCM drains. That interval must submit silence, not later program audio. */
331 atomic_store_explicit(&channel->plus_radio_tx_active,
332 !!channel->radio->txPttIn || hold->engine_ptt_out,
333 memory_order_release);
334 usbradioplus_publish_hardware_ptt(channel, channel->radio->txPttOut);
335}

337void usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_reset(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
338{
339 struct usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold *hold;
340
341 if (!channel)
342 return;
343 hold = &channel->plus_tx_playout_hold;
344 if (channel->radio && hold->draining)
345 channel->radio->txPttOut = hold->engine_ptt_out;
346 hold->callbacks_remaining = 0U;
347 hold->engine_ptt_out = 0;
348 hold->input_keyed = 0;
349 hold->draining = 0;
350}

352void usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_note_output(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel, int submitted,
353 int audio_bearing, unsigned int callbacks)
354{
355 struct usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold *hold;
356
357 if (!channel || !channel->radio || !submitted)
358 return;
359 hold = &channel->plus_tx_playout_hold;
360 /* The adapter already includes the requested 20 ms safety block in this
361 * rounded native-callback count. A zero estimate still keeps one block. */
362 if (audio_bearing) {
363 hold->callbacks_remaining = callbacks ? callbacks : 1U;
364 } else if (hold->callbacks_remaining) {
365 /* Only a complete DAC submission advances the drain clock. A full
366 * device queue therefore extends PTT instead of cutting queued PCM off. */
367 --hold->callbacks_remaining;
368 }
369}

404int usbradioplus_read_radio_program_request(const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o,
405 struct usbradioplus_radio_program_request *request)
406{
407 if (!o || !request)
408 return 0;
409 for (unsigned int attempt = 0; attempt < 2U; ++attempt) {
410 unsigned int before;
411 unsigned int after;
412
413 before = atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_generation,
414 memory_order_acquire);
415 if (before & 1U)
416 continue;
417 request->rx_frequency = atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_rx_frequency,
418 memory_order_relaxed);
419 request->tx_frequency = atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_tx_frequency,
420 memory_order_relaxed);
421 request->high_power = atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_high_power,
422 memory_order_relaxed);
423#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
424 if (atomic_load_explicit(&test_radio_program_snapshot_invalidations,
425 memory_order_relaxed) != 0U)
426 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&test_radio_program_snapshot_invalidations, 1U,
427 memory_order_relaxed);
428#endif
429 after = atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_generation,
430 memory_order_acquire);
431#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
432 if (atomic_load_explicit(&test_radio_program_snapshot_invalidations,
433 memory_order_relaxed) != 0U)
434 ++after;
435#endif
436 /* A matching generation is necessarily even: odd values were rejected
437 * before reading the payload. */
438 if (before == after) {
439 request->generation = after;
440 return 1;
441 }
442 }
443 return 0;
444}

482void usbradioplus_interface_mode(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel, int advanced)
483{
484 channel->plus_advanced = advanced;
485 channel->plus_app_rpt_rate = advanced ? URP_RATE_NATIVE : URP_APP_RPT_RATE_DEFAULT;
486 channel->plus_app_rpt_samples = channel->plus_app_rpt_rate / 50;
487 /* The shared ring owns the one persistent app_rpt-to-native conversion and
488 * clock correction stream. Its source-rate target steers clock recovery;
489 * it never delays startup or reserves a block from playout. */
490 channel->plus_program_target_samples =
491 (channel->plus_app_rpt_rate * URP_PROGRAM_RING_TARGET_MS + 999U) / 1000U;
492 if (rpcr_set_rates(&channel->plus_program_ring, channel->plus_app_rpt_rate,
493 URP_RATE_NATIVE))
494 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: unable to configure program sample rates\n",
495 channel->name);
496 /* The native renderer owns SRC history and resets it after it observes the
497 * graph generation carrying this rate. No control-plane thread touches a
498 * live converter. */
499 if (channel->plus_dsp_initialized) {
500 if (usbradioplus_prepare_native_processing(channel))
501 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: unable to apply native interface mode\n",
502 channel->name);
503 }
504}

517void usbradioplus_queue_program(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const short *samples, size_t count)
518{
519 uint64_t discarded =
520 atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_program_ring.discarded, memory_order_relaxed);
521 size_t index;
522
523 if (!samples || !count)
524 return;
525 /* This is the sole app_rpt-to-hardware boundary. Publish one sample at a
526 * time so the producer and native consumer advance independent SPSC cursors
527 * without a frame admission lock or a startup batch. */
528 for (index = 0; index < count; ++index)
529 (void)rpcr_producer_push_sample(&o->plus_program_ring, samples[index]);
530 if (atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_program_ring.discarded, memory_order_relaxed) !=
531 discarded)
532 o->plus_link_queue_overflows++;
533}

535void usbradioplus_echo_clear(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
536{
537 /* Stop admission immediately, then let the callback renderer discard with
538 * its owned consumer cursor at the next complete render boundary. Resetting
539 * both cursors here would race active legacy-echo recording. */
540 atomic_store_explicit(&o->echoing, 0, memory_order_release);
541 usbradioplus_native_renderer_clear_legacy_echo(o);
542}

552void usbradioplus_echo_record(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const short *samples, size_t count)
553{
554 unsigned int app_samples =
555 o->plus_app_rpt_samples ? o->plus_app_rpt_samples : URP_APP_RPT_RATE_DEFAULT / 50U;
556 unsigned int capacity;
557
558 if (o->echomax <= 0 || atomic_load_explicit(&o->echoing, memory_order_acquire))
559 return;
560 if ((unsigned int)o->echomax > URP_ECHO_QUEUE_SAMPLES / app_samples)
561 capacity = URP_ECHO_QUEUE_SAMPLES;
562 else
563 capacity = (unsigned int)o->echomax * app_samples;
564 while (count-- && urp_sample_queue_samples(&o->echo_queue) < capacity) {
565 if (!urp_sample_queue_push_sample(&o->echo_queue, *samples))
566 break;
567 ++samples;
568 }
569}

580int usbradio_indicate(struct ast_channel *c, int cond_in, const void *data, size_t datalen)
581{
582 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = ast_channel_tech_pvt(c);
583 enum ast_control_frame_type cond = cond_in;
584
585 switch (cond) {
586 case AST_CONTROL_BUSY:
587 case AST_CONTROL_CONGESTION:
588 case AST_CONTROL_RINGING:
589 break;
590 case AST_CONTROL_VIDUPDATE:
591 break;
592 case AST_CONTROL_HOLD:
593 ast_verbose("Channel %s: Console has been placed on hold.\n", o->name);
594 ast_moh_start(c, data, "default");
595 break;
596 case AST_CONTROL_UNHOLD:
597 ast_verbose("Channel %s: Console has been retrieved from hold.\n", o->name);
598 ast_moh_stop(c);
599 break;
600 case AST_CONTROL_PROCEEDING:
601 ast_verbose("Channel %s: Call Proceeding.\n", o->name);
602 ast_moh_stop(c);
603 break;
604 case AST_CONTROL_PROGRESS:
605 ast_verbose("Channel %s: Call Progress.\n", o->name);
606 ast_moh_stop(c);
607 break;
608 case AST_CONTROL_RADIO_KEY:
609 ast_debug(5, "URP_TXTRACE channel=%s event=request key=1\n", o->name);
610 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txkeyed, 1, memory_order_release);
611 kickptt(o);
612 ast_debug(1, "Channel %s: ACRK code=%s TX ON.\n", o->name, (char *)data);
613 if (datalen && ((char *)(data))[0] != '0') {
614 o->forcetxcode = 1;
615 memset(o->set_txctcssfreq, 0,
616 sizeof(o->set_txctcssfreq)); /* Possibly unnecessary, if this is used
617 as a string? */
618 ast_copy_string(o->set_txctcssfreq, data, sizeof(o->set_txctcssfreq));
619 radio_config(o);
620 }
621 break;
622 case AST_CONTROL_RADIO_UNKEY:
623 ast_debug(5, "URP_TXTRACE channel=%s event=request key=0\n", o->name);
624 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txkeyed, 0, memory_order_release);
625 kickptt(o);
626 ast_debug(1, "Channel %s: ACRUK TX OFF.\n", o->name);
627 if (o->forcetxcode) {
628 o->forcetxcode = 0;
629 o->radio->pTxCodeDefault = o->txctcssdefault;
630 ast_debug(1, "Channel %s: Forced Tx Squelch Code cleared.\n", o->name);
631 }
632 break;
633 default:
634 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "Channel %s: Don't know how to display condition %d.\n",
635 o->name, cond);
636 return -1;
637 }
638
639 return 0;
640}
641
642int usbradio_setoption(struct ast_channel *chan, int option, void *data, int datalen)
643{
644 const char *cp;
645 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = ast_channel_tech_pvt(chan);
646
647 /* all supported options require data */
648 if (!data || (datalen < 1)) {
649 errno = EINVAL;
650 return -1;
651 }
652
653 switch (option) {
654 case AST_OPTION_TONE_VERIFY:
655 cp = data;
656 switch (*cp) {
657 case 1:
658 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "Channel %s: Set option TONE VERIFY, mode: OFF(0).\n",
659 o->name);
660 o->usedtmf = 1;
661 break;
662 case 2:
663 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
664 "Channel %s: Set option TONE VERIFY, mode: MUTECONF/MAX(2).\n",
665 o->name);
666 o->usedtmf = 1;
667 break;
668 case 3:
669 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE,
670 "Channel %s: Set option TONE VERIFY, mode: DISABLE DETECT(3).\n",
671 o->name);
672 o->usedtmf = 0;
673 break;
674 default:
675 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "Channel %s: Set option TONE VERIFY, mode: OFF(0).\n",
676 o->name);
677 o->usedtmf = 1;
678 break;
679 }
680 break;
681 default:
682 break;
683 }
684 errno = 0;
685 return 0;
686}

715
716void tune_flash(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int intflag)
717{
718
719#define NFLASH 3
720
721 int i;
722
723 if (fd > 0) {
724 ast_cli(fd, "Channel %s: USB Device Flash starting.\n", o->name);
725 }
726 for (i = 0; i < NFLASH; i++) {
727 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 1, memory_order_release);
728 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_test_tone_enabled, 1, memory_order_release);
729 if ((fd > 0) && intflag) {
730 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 1000, intflag)) {
731 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 0, memory_order_release);
732 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_test_tone_enabled, 0,
733 memory_order_release);
734 break;
735 }
736 } else {
737 usleep(1000000);
738 }
739 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_test_tone_enabled, 0, memory_order_release);
740 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 0, memory_order_release);
741 if (i < (NFLASH - 1) && (fd > 0) && intflag) {
742 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 1500, intflag)) {
743 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 0, memory_order_release);
744 break;
745 }
746 } else if (i < (NFLASH - 1)) {
747 usleep(1500000);
748 }
749 }
750 if (fd > 0) {
751 ast_cli(fd, "Channel %s: USB Device Flash completed.\n", o->name);
752 }
753 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 0, memory_order_release);
754 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_test_tone_enabled, 0, memory_order_release);
755}
756
757int radio_tune(int fd, int argc, const char *const *argv)
758{
759 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o = find_desc(usbradio_active);
760 int i;
761
762 if ((argc < 3) || (argc > 4)) {
763 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
764 }
765
766 o->radio->b.tuning = 1;
767
768 if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "dump")) {
769 radio_dump(o, fd);
770 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "swap")) {
771 if (argc > 3) {
772 usb_device_swap(fd, argv[3]);
773 return RESULT_SUCCESS;
774 }
775 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
776 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "menu-support")) {
777 if (argc > 3) {
778 tune_menusupport(fd, o, argv[3]);
779 }
780 return RESULT_SUCCESS;
781 }
782
783 if (!o->hasusb) {
784 ast_cli(fd, USB_UNASSIGNED_FMT, o->name, o->devstr);
785 return RESULT_SUCCESS;
786 }
787
788 if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "rxnoise")) {
789 tune_rxinput(fd, o, 0, 0);
790 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "rxvoice")) {
791 tune_rxvoice(fd, o, 0);
792 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "rxtone")) {
793 tune_rxctcss(fd, o, 0);
794 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "flash")) {
795 tune_flash(fd, o, 0);
796 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "rxsquelch")) {
797 if (argc == 3) {
798 ast_cli(fd, "Current Signal Strength is %d\n",
799 ((32767 - o->radio->rxRssi) * 1000 / 32767));
800 ast_cli(fd, "Current Squelch setting is %d\n", o->rxsquelchadj);
801 } else {
802 i = atoi(argv[3]);
803 if ((i < 0) || (i > 999)) {
804 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
805 }
806 ast_cli(fd, "Changed Squelch setting to %d\n", i);
807 o->rxsquelchadj = i;
808 *(o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust) = ((999 - i) * 32767) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT;
809 }
810 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "txvoice")) {
811 i = 0;
812
813 if ((o->txmixa != TX_OUT_VOICE) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_VOICE) &&
814 (o->txmixa != TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
815 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "No txvoice output configured.\n");
816 } else if (argc == 3) {
817 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
818 ast_cli(fd, "Current txvoice setting on Channel A is %d\n",
819 o->txmixaset);
820 } else {
821 ast_cli(fd, "Current txvoice setting on Channel B is %d\n",
822 o->txmixbset);
823 }
824 } else {
825 i = atoi(argv[3]);
826 if ((i < 0) || (i > 999)) {
827 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
828 }
829
830 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
831 o->txmixaset = i;
832 ast_cli(fd, "Changed txvoice setting on Channel A to %d\n",
833 o->txmixaset);
834 } else {
835 o->txmixbset = i;
836 ast_cli(fd, "Changed txvoice setting on Channel B to %d\n",
837 o->txmixbset);
838 }
839 mixer_write(o);
840 mult_set(o);
841 ast_cli(fd, "Changed Tx Voice Output setting to %d\n", i);
842 }
843 o->radio->b.txCtcssInhibit = 1;
844 tune_txoutput(o, i, fd, 0);
845 o->radio->b.txCtcssInhibit = 0;
846 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "txall")) {
847 i = 0;
848
849 if ((o->txmixa != TX_OUT_VOICE) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_VOICE) &&
850 (o->txmixa != TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
851 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "No txvoice output configured.\n");
852 } else if (argc == 3) {
853 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
854 ast_cli(fd, "Current txvoice setting on Channel A is %d\n",
855 o->txmixaset);
856 } else {
857 ast_cli(fd, "Current txvoice setting on Channel B is %d\n",
858 o->txmixbset);
859 }
860 } else {
861 i = atoi(argv[3]);
862 if ((i < 0) || (i > 999)) {
863 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
864 }
865
866 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
867 o->txmixaset = i;
868 ast_cli(fd, "Changed txvoice setting on Channel A to %d\n",
869 o->txmixaset);
870 } else {
871 o->txmixbset = i;
872 ast_cli(fd, "Changed txvoice setting on Channel B to %d\n",
873 o->txmixbset);
874 }
875 mixer_write(o);
876 mult_set(o);
877 ast_cli(fd, "Changed Tx Voice Output setting to %d\n", i);
878 }
879 tune_txoutput(o, i, fd, 0);
880 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "auxvoice")) {
881 if ((o->txmixa != TX_OUT_AUX) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_AUX)) {
882 ast_log(LOG_WARNING, "No auxvoice output configured.\n");
883 } else if (argc == 3) {
884 if (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_AUX) {
885 ast_cli(fd, "Current auxvoice setting on Channel A is %d\n",
886 o->txmixaset);
887 } else {
888 ast_cli(fd, "Current auxvoice setting on Channel B is %d\n",
889 o->txmixbset);
890 }
891 } else {
892 i = atoi(argv[3]);
893 if ((i < 0) || (i > 999)) {
894 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
895 }
896 if (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_AUX) {
897 o->txmixaset = i;
898 ast_cli(fd, "Changed auxvoice setting on Channel A to %d\n",
899 o->txmixaset);
900 } else {
901 o->txmixbset = i;
902 ast_cli(fd, "Changed auxvoice setting on Channel B to %d\n",
903 o->txmixbset);
904 }
905 mixer_write(o);
906 mult_set(o);
907 }
908 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "txtone")) {
909 if (argc == 3) {
910 ast_cli(fd, "Current Tx CTCSS modulation setting = %d\n", o->txctcssadj);
911 } else {
912 i = atoi(argv[3]);
913 if ((i < 0) || (i > 999)) {
914 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
915 }
916 o->txctcssadj = i;
917 o->ctcss_level = 32767.0 * (double)i / 999.0;
918 set_txctcss_level(o);
919 ast_cli(fd, "Changed Tx CTCSS modulation setting to %i\n", i);
920 }
921 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 1, memory_order_release);
922 usleep(5000000);
923 atomic_store_explicit(&o->txtestkey, 0, memory_order_release);
924 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "save")) {
925 tune_write(o);
926 ast_cli(fd, "Saved radio tuning settings.\n");
927 } else if (!strcasecmp(argv[2], "load")) {
928 ast_mutex_lock(&o->eepromlock);
929 while (o->eepromctl) {
930 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->eepromlock);
931 usleep(10000);
932 ast_mutex_lock(&o->eepromlock);
933 }
934 o->eepromctl = 1; /* request a load */
935 ast_mutex_unlock(&o->eepromlock);
936
937 ast_cli(fd, "Requesting loading of tuning settings from EEPROM for channel %s\n",
938 o->name);
939 } else {
940 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
941 return RESULT_SHOWUSAGE;
942 }
943 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
944 return RESULT_SUCCESS;
945}

1061
1062void refresh_processing_hardware(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1063{
1064 struct usbradioplus_hardware_settings hardware;
1065 int rx, a, b, route_a, route_b;
1066 int output_gain_a, output_gain_b;
1067
1068 if (!o || !o->radio)
1069 return;
1070 /* Take one immutable settings copy so a reload cannot mix old and new
1071 * hardware fields within one mixer update. This control-plane operation may
1072 * call mixer_write(), which takes an adapter lock on modern devices. */
1073 usbradioplus_processing_get_hardware_rt(o->name, &hardware);
1074 rx = urp_gain_db_to_mixer(hardware.input_gain_db);
1075 a = urp_gain_db_to_mixer(hardware.output_a_gain_db);
1076 b = urp_gain_db_to_mixer(hardware.output_b_gain_db);
1077 route_a = hardware.output_a_assignment;
1078 route_b = hardware.output_b_assignment;
1079 /* A changed code map must go through radio_config(). Besides selecting the
1080 * direction-specific sources, that routine owns the parser's control-plane
1081 * quiesce protocol. Calling urp_radio_parse_codes() here used to free a
1082 * decoder filter while the hardware callback could still be using it. */
1083 if (!o->remoted && (strcmp(o->rxctcssfreqs, o->plus_applied_rxctcssfreqs) ||
1084 strcmp(o->txctcssfreqs, o->plus_applied_txctcssfreqs)))
1085 (void)radio_config(o);
1086 if (o->plus_hardware_applied && rx == o->plus_applied_rxmixer &&
1087 a == o->plus_applied_txmixaset && b == o->plus_applied_txmixbset &&
1088 route_a == atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_applied_txmixa, memory_order_acquire) &&
1089 route_b == atomic_load_explicit(&o->plus_applied_txmixb, memory_order_acquire))
1090 return;
1091 o->plus_applied_rxmixer = rx;
1092 o->plus_applied_txmixaset = a;
1093 o->plus_applied_txmixbset = b;
1094 mixer_write(o);
1095 output_gain_a = urp_hardware_level_multiplier((a * 152) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT);
1096 output_gain_b = route_a == route_b
1097 ? output_gain_a
1098 : urp_hardware_level_multiplier((b * 152) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT);
1099 o->radio->txOutputGainA = output_gain_a;
1100 o->radio->txOutputGainB = output_gain_b;
1101 /* Publish a coherent snapshot only after the device has accepted the mixer
1102 * state. The native tick retries an odd generation instead of taking either
1103 * device_lock or settings_lock in the audio callback. */
1104 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&o->plus_hardware_generation, 1U, memory_order_release);
1105 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_applied_tx_output_gain_a, output_gain_a,
1106 memory_order_relaxed);
1107 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_applied_tx_output_gain_b, output_gain_b,
1108 memory_order_relaxed);
1109 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_applied_txmixa, route_a, memory_order_relaxed);
1110 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_applied_txmixb, route_b, memory_order_relaxed);
1111 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&o->plus_hardware_generation, 1U, memory_order_release);
1112 o->plus_hardware_applied = 1;
1113}

1115int usbradioplus_refresh_all_processing_hardware(void)
1116{
1117 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel;
1118
1119 for (channel = usbradioplus_channel_first(); channel; channel = channel->next)
1120 refresh_processing_hardware(channel);
1121 return 0;
1122}

1133void tune_txoutput(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int value, int fd, int intflag)
1134{
1135 (void)value;

1138 if (fd > 0) {

1140 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 5000, intflag)) {

1143 }

1153
1154void tune_rxdisplay(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1155{
1156 int j, waskeyed, meas, ncols = 75;
1157 char str[256];
1158
1159 ast_cli(fd, "RX VOICE DISPLAY:\n");
1160 ast_cli(fd, " v -- 3KHz v -- 5KHz\n");
1161
1162 if (!o->radio->spsMeasure) {
1163 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: NO MEASURE BLOCK.\n");
1164 return;
1165 }
1166
1167 if (!o->radio->spsMeasure->source || !o->radio->prxVoiceAdjust) {
1168 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: NO SOURCE OR MEASURE SETTING.\n");
1169 return;
1170 }
1171
1172 o->radio->spsMeasure->source = o->radio->spsRxOut->sink;
1173
1174 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 1;
1175 o->radio->spsMeasure->discfactor = 1000;
1176
1177 waskeyed = !o->rxkeyed;
1178 for (;;) {
1179 o->radio->spsMeasure->amax = o->radio->spsMeasure->amin = 0;
1180 if (ast_radio_poll_input(fd, 100)) {
1181 break;
1182 }
1183 if (o->rxkeyed != waskeyed) {
1184 for (j = 0; j < ncols; j++) {
1185 str[j] = ' ';
1186 }
1187 str[j] = 0;
1188 ast_cli(fd, " %s \r", str);
1189 }
1190 waskeyed = o->rxkeyed;
1191 if (!o->rxkeyed) {
1192 ast_cli(fd, "\r");
1193 continue;
1194 }
1195 meas = o->radio->spsMeasure->apeak;
1196 for (j = 0; j < ncols; j++) {
1197 int thresh = (meas * ncols) / 16384;
1198 if (j < thresh) {
1199 str[j] = '=';
1200 } else if (j == thresh) {
1201 str[j] = '>';
1202 } else {
1203 str[j] = ' ';
1204 }
1205 }
1206 str[j] = 0;
1207 ast_cli(fd, "|%s|\r", str);
1208 }
1209 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 0;
1210}
1211
1212void tune_rxtx_status(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1213{
1214 int wasverbose;
1215
1216 ast_cli(fd, "Receiver/Transmitter Status Display:\n");
1217 ast_cli(fd, " COS | CTCSS | COS | PTT\n");
1218 ast_cli(fd, " Input | Input | Out | Out\n");
1219
1220 wasverbose = option_verbose;
1221 option_verbose = 0;
1222
1223 for (;;) {
1224 /* If they press any key, exit live display */
1225 if (ast_radio_poll_input(fd, 200)) {
1226 break;
1227 }
1228 ast_cli(fd, " %s | %s | %s | %s\r",
1229 o->rxcdtype ? (o->rx_cos_active ? "Keyed" : "Clear") : "Off ",
1230 o->rxsdtype ? (o->rx_ctcss_active ? "Keyed" : "Clear") : "Off ",
1231 o->rxkeyed ? "Keyed" : "Clear",
1232 (atomic_load_explicit(&o->txkeyed, memory_order_acquire) ||
1233 atomic_load_explicit(&o->txtestkey, memory_order_acquire))
1234 ? "Keyed"
1235 : "Clear");
1236 }
1237
1238 option_verbose = wasverbose;
1239}

1241int parse_tune_level(const char *text, int *level)
1242{
1243 char *end;
1244 unsigned long value;
1245
1246 if (!text || !*text || !level)
1247 return -1;
1248 value = strtoul(text, &end, 10);
1249 if (*end || value > 999)
1250 return -1;
1251 *level = (int)value;
1252 return 0;
1253}

1275void _menu_txvoice(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const char *cstr)
1276{
1277 const char *str = cstr;
1278 int i, j, dokey, withctcss;
1279
1280 if ((o->txmixa != TX_OUT_VOICE) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_VOICE) &&
1281 (o->txmixa != TX_OUT_COMPOSITE) && (o->txmixb != TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
1282 ast_cli(fd, "Error, No txvoice output configured.\n");
1283 return;
1284 }
1285 if (!str[0]) {
1286 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
1287 ast_cli(fd, "Current Tx Voice Level setting on Channel A is %d\n",
1288 o->txmixaset);
1289 } else {
1290 ast_cli(fd, "Current Tx Voice Level setting on Channel B is %d\n",
1291 o->txmixbset);
1292 }
1293 return;
1294 }
1295 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
1296 j = o->txmixaset;
1297 } else {
1298 j = o->txmixbset;
1299 }
1300 dokey = 0;
1301 if (str[0] == 'K') {
1302 dokey = 1;
1303 str++;
1304 }
1305 withctcss = 0;
1306 if (str[0] == 'C') {
1307 withctcss = 1;
1308 str++;
1309 }
1310 if (!str[0]) {
1311 ast_cli(fd, "Keying Transmitter and sending 1000 Hz tone for 5 seconds...\n");
1312 if (withctcss) {
1313 o->radio->b.txCtcssInhibit = 1;
1314 }
1315 tune_txoutput(o, j, fd, 1);
1316 o->radio->b.txCtcssInhibit = 0;
1317 ast_cli(fd, "DONE.\n");
1318 return;
1319 }
1320 if (parse_tune_level(str, &i)) {
1321 ast_cli(fd, "Entry Error, Tx Voice Level setting not changed\n");
1322 return;
1323 }
1324 if ((o->txmixa == TX_OUT_VOICE) || (o->txmixa == TX_OUT_COMPOSITE)) {
1325 o->txmixaset = i;
1326 ast_cli(fd, "Changed Tx Voice Level setting on Channel A to %d\n", o->txmixaset);
1327 } else {
1328 o->txmixbset = i;
1329 ast_cli(fd, "Changed Tx Voice Level setting on Channel B to %d\n", o->txmixbset);
1330 }
1331 mixer_write(o);
1332 mult_set(o);
1333 if (dokey) {
1334 ast_cli(fd, "Keying Transmitter and sending 1000 Hz tone for 5 seconds...\n");
1335 if (!withctcss) {
1336 o->radio->b.txCtcssInhibit = 1;
1337 }
1338 tune_txoutput(o, i, fd, 1);
1339 o->radio->b.txCtcssInhibit = 0;
1340 ast_cli(fd, "DONE.\n");
1341 }
1342}

1410void tune_rxvoice(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int intflag)
1411{
1412 const int target = 7200; /* peak */
1413 const int tolerance = 360; /* peak to peak */
1414 const float settingmin = 0.1;
1415 const float settingmax = 5;
1416 const float settingstart = 1;
1417 const int maxtries = 12;
1418
1419 float setting;
1420
1421 int tries = 0, meas;
1422
1423 ast_cli(fd, "INFO: RX VOICE ADJUST START.\n");
1424 ast_cli(fd, "target=%i tolerance=%i \n", target, tolerance);
1425
1426 o->radio->b.tuning = 1;
1427 if (!o->radio->spsMeasure) {
1428 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: NO MEASURE BLOCK.\n");
1429 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1430 return;
1431 }
1432
1433 if (!o->radio->spsMeasure->source || !o->radio->prxVoiceAdjust) {
1434 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: NO SOURCE OR MEASURE SETTING.\n");
1435 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1436 return;
1437 }
1438
1439 o->radio->spsMeasure->source = o->radio->spsRxOut->sink;
1440 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 1;
1441 o->radio->spsMeasure->discfactor = 1000;
1442
1443 setting = settingstart;
1444
1445 while (tries < maxtries) {
1446 *(o->radio->prxVoiceAdjust) = setting * M_Q8;
1447 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 10, intflag)) {
1448 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1449 return;
1450 }
1451 o->radio->spsMeasure->amax = o->radio->spsMeasure->amin = 0;
1452 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 1000, intflag)) {
1453 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1454 return;
1455 }
1456 meas = o->radio->spsMeasure->apeak;
1457 ast_cli(fd, "tries=%i, setting=%f, meas=%i\n", tries, setting, meas);
1458
1459 if (meas < (target - tolerance) || meas > (target + tolerance) || tries < 3) {
1460 setting = setting * target / meas;
1461 } else if (tries > 4 && meas > (target - tolerance) &&
1462 meas < (target + tolerance)) {
1463 break;
1464 }
1465 if (setting < settingmin) {
1466 setting = settingmin;
1467 } else if (setting > settingmax) {
1468 setting = settingmax;
1469 }
1470
1471 tries++;
1472 }
1473
1474 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 0;
1475
1476 ast_cli(fd, "DONE tries=%i, setting=%f, meas=%f\n", tries, setting, (float)meas);
1477 if (meas < (target - tolerance) || meas > (target + tolerance)) {
1478 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: RX VOICE GAIN ADJUST FAILED.\n");
1479 } else {
1480 ast_cli(fd, "INFO: RX VOICE GAIN ADJUST SUCCESS.\n");
1481 usbradioplus_processing_set_local_input_gain(
1482 o->name, 20.0 * log10(fmax(0.000001, 2.0 * setting)));
1483 }
1484 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1485}
1486
1487void tune_rxctcss(int fd, struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int intflag)
1488{
1489 const int target = 2400; /* was 4096 pre 20080205 */
1490 const int tolerance = 100;
1491 const float settingmin = 0.1;
1492 const float settingmax = 8;
1493 const float settingstart = 1;
1494 const int maxtries = 12;
1495
1496 float setting;
1497 int tries = 0, meas;
1498
1499 ast_cli(fd, "INFO: RX CTCSS ADJUST START.\n");
1500 ast_cli(fd, "target=%i tolerance=%i \n", target, tolerance);
1501
1502 o->radio->b.tuning = 1;
1503 o->radio->spsMeasure->source = o->radio->prxCtcssMeasure;
1504 o->radio->spsMeasure->discfactor = 400;
1505 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 1;
1506
1507 setting = settingstart;
1508
1509 while (tries < maxtries) {
1510 *(o->radio->prxCtcssAdjust) = setting * M_Q8;
1511 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 10, intflag)) {
1512 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1513 return;
1514 }
1515 o->radio->spsMeasure->amax = o->radio->spsMeasure->amin = 0;
1516 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 500, intflag)) {
1517 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1518 return;
1519 }
1520 meas = o->radio->spsMeasure->apeak;
1521 ast_cli(fd, "tries=%i, setting=%f, meas=%i\n", tries, setting, meas);
1522
1523 if (meas < (target - tolerance) || meas > (target + tolerance) || tries < 3) {
1524 setting = setting * target / meas;
1525 } else if (tries > 4 && meas > (target - tolerance) &&
1526 meas < (target + tolerance)) {
1527 break;
1528 }
1529 if (setting < settingmin) {
1530 setting = settingmin;
1531 } else if (setting > settingmax) {
1532 setting = settingmax;
1533 }
1534
1535 tries++;
1536 }
1537 o->radio->spsMeasure->enabled = 0;
1538 ast_cli(fd, "DONE tries=%i, setting=%f, meas=%.2f\n", tries, setting, (float)meas);
1539 if (meas < (target - tolerance) || meas > (target + tolerance)) {
1540 ast_cli(fd, "ERROR: RX CTCSS GAIN ADJUST FAILED.\n");
1541 } else {
1542 ast_cli(fd, "INFO: RX CTCSS GAIN ADJUST SUCCESS.\n");
1543 o->rxctcssadj = setting;
1544 }
1545
1546 if (o->rxcdtype == CD_XPMR_NOISE) {
1547 int normRssi;
1548
1549 if (ast_radio_wait_or_poll(fd, 200, intflag)) {
1550 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1551 return;
1552 }
1553
1554 normRssi = ((32767 - o->radio->rxRssi) * AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT / 32767);
1555
1556 if (o->rxsquelchadj > normRssi) {
1557 ast_cli(fd,
1558 "WARNING: RSSI=%i SQUELCH=%i and is too tight. Use 'radio tune "
1559 "rxsquelch'.\n",
1560 normRssi, o->rxsquelchadj);
1561 } else {
1562 ast_cli(fd, "INFO: RX RSSI=%i\n", normRssi);
1563 }
1564 }
1565 o->radio->b.tuning = 0;
1566}
1567
1568void mult_set(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1569{
1570 o->radio->txOutputGainA =
1571 urp_hardware_level_multiplier((effective_txmixaset(o) * 152) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT);
1572 /* Matching output routes share channel A's gain to keep both DAC legs equal. */
1573 o->radio->txOutputGainB =
1574 effective_txmixa(o) == effective_txmixb(o)
1575 ? o->radio->txOutputGainA
1576 : urp_hardware_level_multiplier((effective_txmixbset(o) * 152) /
1577 AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT);
1578}
1579
1580void usbradioplus_program_radio(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1581{
1582 uint32_t rx_freq;
1583 uint32_t tx_freq;
1584 int high_power;
1585
1586 if (!o)
1587 return;
1588 rx_freq = o->remoted ? o->set_rxfreq : o->rxfreq;
1589 tx_freq = o->remoted ? o->set_txfreq : o->txfreq;
1590 high_power = o->remoted ? o->set_txpower : 0;
1591 /* The physical bus belongs to the HID worker. The odd generation brackets
1592 * a coherent control-plane request without making an audio callback wait. */
1593 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_generation, 1U, memory_order_release);
1594 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_rx_frequency, rx_freq, memory_order_relaxed);
1595 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_tx_frequency, tx_freq, memory_order_relaxed);
1596 atomic_store_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_high_power, high_power, memory_order_relaxed);
1597 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&o->plus_radio_program_generation, 1U, memory_order_release);
1598}

1600void usbradioplus_parallel_program_write(void *opaque, uint8_t value)
1601{
1602 (void)opaque;
1603 pp_val = (int8_t)value;
1604 ast_radio_ppwrite(haspp, ppfd, pbase, pport, value);
1605}
1606
1607void usbradioplus_set_channel(uint8_t channel)
1608{
1609 struct urp_parallel_bus bus;
1610 if (!haspp)
1611 return;
1612 ast_mutex_lock(&pp_lock);
1613 bus.value = (uint8_t)pp_val;
1614 bus.write = usbradioplus_parallel_program_write;
1615 bus.opaque = NULL;
1616 urp_hardware_set_channel(&bus, channel);
1617 pp_val = (int8_t)bus.value;
1618 ast_mutex_unlock(&pp_lock);
1619}

1621/* Unit-only control-plane hooks make race outcomes deterministic without being
1622 * present in the installed module. */
1623#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
1624static atomic_int test_radio_access_force_reader_retry;
1625#endif
1626
1639static void radio_access_begin_reconfigure(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
1640{
1641 struct usbradioplus_radio_access_slot *slot = &channel->plus_radio_access;
1642
1643 if (!channel->plus_dsp_initialized)
1644 return;
1645 while (atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_acquire)) {
1646 sched_yield();
1647#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
1648 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_release);
1649#endif
1650 }
1651 atomic_store_explicit(&slot->reconfiguring, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);
1652 while (atomic_load_explicit(&slot->readers, memory_order_seq_cst) != 0U)
1653 sched_yield();
1654}
1655
1659static void radio_access_end_reconfigure(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
1660{
1661 struct usbradioplus_radio_access_slot *slot = &channel->plus_radio_access;
1662
1663 if (!channel->plus_dsp_initialized)
1664 return;
1665 atomic_store_explicit(&slot->reconfiguring, 0, memory_order_seq_cst);
1666 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_release);
1667}
1668
1669int usbradioplus_radio_access_acquire(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
1670{
1671 struct usbradioplus_radio_access_slot *slot;
1672
1673 if (!channel || !channel->radio)
1674 return 0;
1675 /* Unit construction and teardown have no active hardware callback. */
1676 if (!channel->plus_dsp_initialized)
1677 return 1;
1678 slot = &channel->plus_radio_access;
1679 if (atomic_load_explicit(&slot->reconfiguring, memory_order_seq_cst))
1680 return 0;
1681 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&slot->readers, 1U, memory_order_seq_cst);
1682#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
1683 if (atomic_exchange_explicit(&test_radio_access_force_reader_retry, 0,
1684 memory_order_relaxed))
1685 atomic_store_explicit(&slot->reconfiguring, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);
1686#endif
1687 if (!atomic_load_explicit(&slot->reconfiguring, memory_order_seq_cst))
1688 return 1;
1689 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&slot->readers, 1U, memory_order_seq_cst);
1690 return 0;
1691}
1692
1693void usbradioplus_radio_access_release(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
1694{
1695 if (!channel || !channel->radio || !channel->plus_dsp_initialized)
1696 return;
1697 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&channel->plus_radio_access.readers, 1U, memory_order_seq_cst);
1698}
1699
1700#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
1701int usbradioplus_test_radio_access_contention_paths(void)
1702{
1703 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
1704 urp_radio_state radio = {0};
1705
1706 channel.radio = &radio;
1707 channel.plus_dsp_initialized = 1;
1708 atomic_init(&channel.plus_radio_access.readers, 0U);
1709 atomic_init(&channel.plus_radio_access.reconfiguring, 0);
1710 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&channel.plus_radio_access.writer, memory_order_relaxed);
1711 atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit(&channel.plus_radio_access.writer, memory_order_relaxed);
1712 radio_access_begin_reconfigure(&channel);
1713 radio_access_end_reconfigure(&channel);
1714 atomic_store_explicit(&test_radio_access_force_reader_retry, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
1715 (void)usbradioplus_radio_access_acquire(&channel);
1716 return (int)atomic_load_explicit(&channel.plus_radio_access.readers, memory_order_seq_cst);
1717}
1718#endif
1719
1726static int radio_configure_dcs(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel, int receive_dcs, int transmit_dcs)
1727{
1728 /* A disabled direction stores five NUL bytes, matching the canonical code field. */
1729 static const char disabled_dcs_code[5] = "";
1730 int receive_code = -1;
1731 int receive_inverted = 0;
1732 int transmit_code = -1;
1733 int transmit_inverted = 0;
1734 urp_radio_state *radio = channel->radio;
1735
1736 if (receive_dcs &&
1737 urp_dcs_parse_code(channel->dcs_receive_code, &receive_code, &receive_inverted))
1738 return -1;
1739 if (transmit_dcs &&
1740 urp_dcs_parse_code(channel->dcs_transmit_code, &transmit_code, &transmit_inverted))
1741 return -1;
1742 urp_dcs_configure(&radio->dcs, receive_code, receive_inverted, transmit_code,
1743 transmit_inverted);
1744 /* Parsed DCS spellings are exactly four characters plus their NUL terminator. */
1745 memcpy(radio->dcsRxCode, receive_dcs ? channel->dcs_receive_code : disabled_dcs_code,
1746 sizeof(radio->dcsRxCode));
1747 memcpy(radio->dcsTxCode, transmit_dcs ? channel->dcs_transmit_code : disabled_dcs_code,
1748 sizeof(radio->dcsTxCode));
1749 radio->dcsTurnoffEnabled = transmit_dcs && channel->dcs_turnoff_enabled;
1750 radio->dcsTurnoffDuration = transmit_dcs ? channel->dcs_turnoff_duration_ms : 0;
1751 radio->dcsTurnoffTimer = 0;
1752 radio->dcsPeak = transmit_dcs ? channel->dcs_level : 0.0;
1753 if (!receive_dcs && radio->smode == SMODE_DCS) {
1754 radio->smode = SMODE_NULL;
1755 radio->smodewas = SMODE_NULL;
1756 radio->smodetimer = 0;
1757 }
1758 return 0;
1759}
1760
1765static int radio_config_locked(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
1766{
1767 static const char disabled_code[] = "0";
1768 const int receive_ctcss = ast_strlen_zero(o->receive_signaling_method) ||
1769 !strcasecmp(o->receive_signaling_method, "ctcss");
1770 const int transmit_ctcss = ast_strlen_zero(o->transmit_signaling_method) ||
1771 !strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "ctcss");
1772 const int receive_dcs = !strcasecmp(o->receive_signaling_method, "dcs");
1773 const int transmit_dcs = !strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "dcs");
1774 int parse_result;
1775
1776 if (o->radio == NULL) {
1777 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "native radio state is unavailable\n");
1778 return 1;
1779 }
1780
1781 /* Scalar detector and transmitter controls are live state, unlike the
1782 * parser-owned CTCSS lists below. Update them in the same excluded window
1783 * so a native block cannot combine old thresholds with a new decoder map. */
1784 o->radio->rxDemod = o->rxdemod;
1785 o->radio->rxCdType = effective_rxcdtype(o);
1786 o->radio->voxHangTime = o->voxhangtime;
1787 o->radio->rxSqVoxAdj = o->rxsqvoxadj;
1788 o->radio->rxCarrierHyst = o->rxsqhyst;
1789 o->radio->rxNoiseFilType = o->rxnoisefiltype;
1790 o->radio->rxSquelchDelay = o->rxsquelchdelay;
1791 o->radio->rxNoiseSquelchEnable = o->radio->rxCdType == CD_XPMR_NOISE;
1792 o->radio->b.rxpolarity = o->rxpolarity;
1793 o->radio->b.txpolarity = o->txpolarity;
1794 o->radio->b.lsdrxpolarity = o->lsdrxpolarity;
1795 o->radio->b.lsdtxpolarity = o->lsdtxpolarity;
1796 o->radio->txCpuSaver = o->txcpusaver;
1797 o->radio->txsettletime = o->txsettletime;
1798 o->radio->txrxblankingtime = o->txrxblankingtime;
1799 o->radio->rxCtcss->relax = o->rxctcssrelax;
1800 o->radio->txTocType = o->txtoctype;
1801 o->radio->txCtcssTocShift = o->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees;
1802 o->radio->txCtcssTocTime = o->ctcss_tail_duration_ms;
1803 o->radio->txCtcssTocToneHz = o->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz;
1804 /* CTCSS peak is defined at the native PCM output. Hardware mixer gain
1805 * remains an analog-output control and must not alter this configured level. */
1806 o->radio->txCtcssPeak = transmit_ctcss ? o->ctcss_level : 0.0;
1807 if (o->remoted) {
1808 o->radio->pTxCodeDefault = o->set_txctcssdefault;
1809 o->radio->pRxCodeSrc = o->set_rxctcssfreqs;
1810 o->radio->pTxCodeSrc = o->set_txctcssfreqs;
1811
1812 } else {
1813 /* Keep the configured RX and TX CTCSS data independent. The parser
1814 * receives a disabled companion list for a receive-only CTCSS mode,
1815 * which deliberately builds CTCSS_RXONLY entries instead of requiring
1816 * an artificial transmitter map. */
1817 const char *rx_source = receive_ctcss ? o->rxctcssfreqs : disabled_code;
1818 const char *tx_source =
1819 receive_ctcss && transmit_ctcss ? o->txctcssfreqs : disabled_code;
1820 const char *default_source = transmit_ctcss ? o->txctcssdefault : disabled_code;
1821 if (ast_strlen_zero(rx_source))
1822 rx_source = disabled_code;
1823 if (ast_strlen_zero(tx_source))
1824 tx_source = disabled_code;
1825 if (ast_strlen_zero(default_source))
1826 default_source = disabled_code;
1827 o->radio->pTxCodeDefault = (char *)default_source;
1828 ast_copy_string(o->plus_applied_rxctcssfreqs, rx_source,
1829 sizeof(o->plus_applied_rxctcssfreqs));
1830 o->radio->pRxCodeSrc = o->plus_applied_rxctcssfreqs;
1831 ast_copy_string(o->plus_applied_txctcssfreqs, tx_source,
1832 sizeof(o->plus_applied_txctcssfreqs));
1833 o->radio->pTxCodeSrc = o->plus_applied_txctcssfreqs;
1834 }
1835
1836 if (o->forcetxcode) {
1837 o->radio->pTxCodeDefault = o->set_txctcssfreq;
1838 ast_debug(3, "Channel %s: Forced Tx Squelch Code code=%s.\n", o->name,
1839 o->radio->pTxCodeDefault);
1840 }
1841
1842 parse_result = urp_radio_parse_codes(o->radio);
1843 if (parse_result)
1844 return 1;
1845 /* Parsing resets the CTCSS filter gain. Restore the selected decoder and
1846 * transmitter calibration before audio readers can observe this generation. */
1847 if (o->radio->prxCtcssAdjust)
1848 *o->radio->prxCtcssAdjust = (i32)lround(o->rxctcssadj * M_Q8);
1849 if (o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust)
1850 *o->radio->prxSquelchAdjust = ((999 - o->rxsquelchadj) * 32767) / AUDIO_ADJUSTMENT;
1851 if (!receive_ctcss && o->radio->smode == SMODE_CTCSS) {
1852 o->radio->smode = SMODE_NULL;
1853 o->radio->smodewas = SMODE_NULL;
1854 o->radio->smodetimer = 0;
1855 }
1856 if (!transmit_ctcss) {
1857 o->radio->txCtcssEnabled = 0;
1858 o->radio->txCtcssOption = 3;
1859 o->radio->txCtcssState = 0;
1860 o->radio->txCtcssTurnoffTimer = 0;
1861 o->radio->txCtcssTailToneHz = 0.0;
1862 }
1863 if (radio_configure_dcs(o, receive_dcs, transmit_dcs))
1864 return 1;
1865 usbradioplus_program_radio(o);
1866
1867 return 0;
1868}

1901static int ctcss_frequency_list_valid(const char *frequencies, size_t *count)
1902{
1903 const char *cursor = frequencies;
1904 size_t entries = 0;
1905
1906 if (ast_strlen_zero(cursor))
1907 return 0;
1908 for (;;) {
1909 char *end;
1910 double frequency;
1911
1912 errno = 0;
1913 frequency = strtod(cursor, &end);
1914 if (end == cursor || errno == ERANGE || !isfinite(frequency) ||
1915 !urp_ctcss_frequency_supported((float)frequency))
1916 return 0;
1917 ++entries;
1918 cursor = end;
1919 while (*cursor == ' ' || *cursor == '\t')
1920 ++cursor;
1921 if (*cursor == '\0')
1922 break;
1923 if (*cursor != ',')
1924 return 0;
1925 ++cursor;
1926 while (*cursor == ' ' || *cursor == '\t')
1927 ++cursor;
1928 if (*cursor == '\0')
1929 return 0;
1930 }
1931 if (count)
1932 *count = entries;
1933 return 1;
1934}

1941static int ctcss_frequency_lists_mapped(const char *receive_frequencies,
1942 const char *transmit_frequencies)
1943{
1944 size_t receive_count;
1945 size_t transmit_count;
1946
1947 return ctcss_frequency_list_valid(receive_frequencies, &receive_count) &&
1948 ctcss_frequency_list_valid(transmit_frequencies, &transmit_count) &&
1949 receive_count == transmit_count;
1950}
1951
1956static int ctcss_frequency_valid(const char *frequency)
1957{
1958 size_t count;
1959
1960 return ctcss_frequency_list_valid(frequency, &count) && count == 1;
1961}
1962
1967static int dcs_code_valid(const char *code)
1968{
1969 return code && strlen(code) == 4 && code[0] >= '0' && code[0] <= '7' && code[1] >= '0' &&
1970 code[1] <= '7' && code[2] >= '0' && code[2] <= '7' &&
1971 (code[3] == 'N' || code[3] == 'n' || code[3] == 'I' || code[3] == 'i');
1972}
1973

2019 char dcs_receive_code[5];
2021 char dcs_transmit_code[5];
2023 enum radio_rx_audio rxdemod;
2025 enum radio_carrier_detect rxcdtype;
2027 enum radio_squelch_detect rxsdtype;
2029 enum usbradio_carrier_type txtoctype;
2031 int rxcpusaver;
2033 int txcpusaver;
2035 int voxhangtime;
2037 int rxsqvoxadj;
2039 int rxsqhyst;
2041 int rxnoisefiltype;
2043 int rxsquelchdelay;
2045 int rxondelay;
2047 int rxpolarity;
2049 int rxsquelchadj;
2051 int rxfreq;
2053 int lsdrxpolarity;
2055 int txpreemphasis;
2057 int txsettletime;
2059 int txrxblankingtime;
2061 int txoffdelay;
2063 int txpolarity;
2065 int txfreq;
2067 int lsdtxpolarity;
2069 float rxctcssadj;
2071 int rxctcssoverride;
2073 int rxctcssrelax;
2075 double ctcss_level;
2077 double ctcss_phase_shift_degrees;
2079 int ctcss_tail_duration_ms;

2097static int processing_signaling_bool(const char *category, const char *section, const char *name,
2098 int *result)
2099{
2100 char value[64];
2101
2102 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, section, name, value, sizeof(value)) ||
2103 (!ast_true(value) && !ast_false(value)))
2104 return -1;
2105 *result = ast_true(value);
2106 return 0;
2107}
2108
2116static int processing_signaling_int(const char *category, const char *section, const char *name,
2117 int *result)
2118{
2119 char value[64];
2120 char *end;
2121 long number;
2122
2123 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, section, name, value, sizeof(value)))
2124 return -1;
2125 number = strtol(value, &end, 0);
2126 if (end == value || *end)
2127 return -1;
2128 *result = (int)number;
2129 return 0;
2130}
2131
2139static int processing_signaling_double(const char *category, const char *section, const char *name,
2140 double *result)
2141{
2142 char value[64];
2143 char *end;
2144
2145 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, section, name, value, sizeof(value)))
2146 return -1;
2147 *result = strtod(value, &end);
2148 return end == value || *end || !isfinite(*result) ? -1 : 0;
2149}
2150
2166static int resolve_processing_signaling(const char *category,
2167 struct processing_signaling_values *resolved)
2168{
2169 struct usbradioplus_hardware_settings hardware;
2170 char value[512];
2171 enum urp_carrier_source carrier;
2172 enum urp_ctcss_source ctcss_source;
2173 enum urp_rx_audio_mode audio;
2174 enum urp_tone_off_mode tone_off;
2175 double db;
2176
2177 if (!category || !resolved)
2178 return -1;
2179 memset(resolved, 0, sizeof(*resolved));
2180/* Copy one resolved string option into a signaling candidate. */
2181#define SIGNALING_STRING(section, name, field) \
2182 do { \
2183 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, (section), (name), value, \
2184 sizeof(value))) \
2185 return -1; \
2186 ast_copy_string(resolved->field, value, sizeof(resolved->field)); \
2187 } while (0)
2188/* Read one resolved boolean option into a signaling candidate. */
2189#define SIGNALING_BOOL(section, name, field) \
2190 if (processing_signaling_bool(category, (section), (name), &resolved->field)) \
2191 return -1
2192/* Read one resolved integer option into a signaling candidate. */
2193#define SIGNALING_INT(section, name, field) \
2194 if (processing_signaling_int(category, (section), (name), &resolved->field)) \
2195 return -1
2196 SIGNALING_STRING("receive", "signaling_method", receive_method);
2197 SIGNALING_STRING("transmit", "signaling_method", transmit_method);
2198 if (strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "carrier") &&
2199 strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "ctcss") &&
2200 strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "dcs"))
2201 return -1;
2202 if (strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "carrier") &&
2203 strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "ctcss") &&
2204 strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "dcs"))
2205 return -1;
2206 /* Resolve the candidate's output assignments with its signaling controls.
2207 * A live reload must not accept CTCSS or DCS transmit selection that has no
2208 * configured path to the CM119 DAC. */
2209 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_hardware(category, &hardware) ||
2210 urp_tx_signaling_route_missing(!strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "ctcss") ||
2211 !strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "dcs"),
2212 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)hardware.output_a_assignment,
2213 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)hardware.output_b_assignment))
2214 return -1;
2215 SIGNALING_BOOL("receive", "cpu_saver_enabled", rxcpusaver);
2216 SIGNALING_BOOL("transmit", "cpu_saver_enabled", txcpusaver);
2217 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, "receive", "audio_source", value,
2218 sizeof(value)) ||
2219 urp_parse_rx_audio_mode(value, &audio))
2220 return -1;
2221 resolved->rxdemod = (enum radio_rx_audio)audio;
2222 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, "receive", "cos_assignment", value,
2223 sizeof(value)) ||
2224 urp_parse_carrier_source(value, &carrier))
2225 return -1;
2226 resolved->rxcdtype = (enum radio_carrier_detect)carrier;
2227 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, "ctcss", "receive_source", value,
2228 sizeof(value)) ||
2229 urp_parse_ctcss_source(value, &ctcss_source))
2230 return -1;
2231 resolved->rxsdtype = (enum radio_squelch_detect)ctcss_source;
2232 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "vox_hang_ms", voxhangtime);
2233 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "vox_threshold", rxsqvoxadj);
2234 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "noise_squelch_hysteresis", rxsqhyst);
2235 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "noise_filter_type", rxnoisefiltype);
2236 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "squelch_delay_ms", rxsquelchdelay);
2237 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "on_delay_frames", rxondelay);
2238 SIGNALING_BOOL("receive", "polarity_inverted", rxpolarity);
2239 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "squelch_level", rxsquelchadj);
2240 SIGNALING_INT("receive", "frequency_hz", rxfreq);
2241 SIGNALING_BOOL("receive", "lsd_polarity_inverted", lsdrxpolarity);
2242 SIGNALING_BOOL("transmit", "preemphasis_enabled", txpreemphasis);
2243 SIGNALING_INT("transmit", "settle_ms", txsettletime);
2244 SIGNALING_INT("transmit", "rx_blanking_ms", txrxblankingtime);
2245 SIGNALING_INT("transmit", "off_delay_frames", txoffdelay);
2246 SIGNALING_BOOL("transmit", "polarity_inverted", txpolarity);
2247 SIGNALING_INT("transmit", "frequency_hz", txfreq);
2248 SIGNALING_BOOL("transmit", "lsd_polarity_inverted", lsdtxpolarity);
2249 SIGNALING_STRING("ctcss", "receive_frequencies", receive_ctcss);
2250 SIGNALING_STRING("ctcss", "transmit_frequencies", transmit_ctcss);
2251 SIGNALING_STRING("ctcss", "transmit_default_hz", transmit_ctcss_default);
2252 if ((!ast_strlen_zero(resolved->receive_ctcss) &&
2253 !ctcss_frequency_list_valid(resolved->receive_ctcss, NULL)) ||
2254 (!ast_strlen_zero(resolved->transmit_ctcss) &&
2255 !ctcss_frequency_list_valid(resolved->transmit_ctcss, NULL)) ||
2256 (!ast_strlen_zero(resolved->transmit_ctcss_default) &&
2257 !ctcss_frequency_valid(resolved->transmit_ctcss_default)))
2258 return -1;
2259 if (processing_signaling_double(category, "ctcss", "receive_decoder_gain_db", &db))
2260 return -1;
2261 resolved->rxctcssadj = (float)pow(10.0, db / 20.0);
2262 SIGNALING_BOOL("ctcss", "receive_override_enabled", rxctcssoverride);
2263 /* A CTCSS override has no meaning for carrier or DCS receive. Treat an
2264 * inactive setting as inert rather than letting it bypass their decoder. */
2265 if (strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "ctcss"))
2266 resolved->rxctcssoverride = 0;
2267 SIGNALING_INT("ctcss", "receive_relax", rxctcssrelax);
2268 if (processing_signaling_double(category, "ctcss", "transmit_peak_dbfs", &db))
2269 return -1;
2270 resolved->ctcss_level = 32767.0 * pow(10.0, db / 20.0);
2271 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, "ctcss", "turnoff_mode", value,
2272 sizeof(value)) ||
2273 urp_parse_tone_off_mode(value, &tone_off))
2274 return -1;
2275 resolved->txtoctype = (enum usbradio_carrier_type)tone_off;
2276 if (processing_signaling_double(category, "ctcss", "phase_shift_degrees",
2277 &resolved->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees) ||
2278 processing_signaling_int(category, "ctcss", "tail_duration_ms",
2279 &resolved->ctcss_tail_duration_ms) ||
2280 processing_signaling_double(category, "ctcss", "tail_frequency_hz",
2281 &resolved->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz))
2282 return -1;
2283 SIGNALING_STRING("dcs", "receive_code", dcs_receive_code);
2284 SIGNALING_STRING("dcs", "transmit_code", dcs_transmit_code);
2285 /* DCS controls are retained across signaling-mode changes, so validate both
2286 * directions before selecting either one. This also makes a later DCS mode
2287 * switch unable to activate a stale invalid code. */
2288 if (!dcs_code_valid(resolved->dcs_receive_code) ||
2289 !dcs_code_valid(resolved->dcs_transmit_code))
2290 return -1;
2291 SIGNALING_BOOL("dcs", "turnoff_code_enabled", dcs_turnoff_enabled);
2292 SIGNALING_INT("dcs", "turnoff_duration_ms", dcs_turnoff_duration_ms);
2293 if (processing_signaling_double(category, "dcs", "peak_dbfs", &db))
2294 return -1;
2295 resolved->dcs_level = 32767.0 * pow(10.0, db / 20.0);
2296 if (!strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "ctcss") &&
2297 (resolved->rxsdtype == SD_IGNORE ||
2298 !ctcss_frequency_list_valid(resolved->receive_ctcss, NULL)))
2299 return -1;
2300 if (!strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "ctcss") &&
2301 !ctcss_frequency_valid(resolved->transmit_ctcss_default))
2302 return -1;
2303 if (!strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "ctcss") &&
2304 !strcasecmp(resolved->transmit_method, "ctcss") &&
2305 !ctcss_frequency_lists_mapped(resolved->receive_ctcss, resolved->transmit_ctcss))
2306 return -1;
2307#undef SIGNALING_INT
2308#undef SIGNALING_BOOL
2309#undef SIGNALING_STRING
2310 return 0;
2311}
2312

2314int usbradioplus_test_resolve_processing_signaling(const char *category, int null_result)
2315{
2316 struct processing_signaling_values resolved;
2317
2318 return resolve_processing_signaling(category, null_result ? NULL : &resolved);
2319}

2326static void commit_processing_signaling(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o,
2327 const struct processing_signaling_values *resolved)
2328{
2329 ast_copy_string(o->receive_signaling_method, resolved->receive_method,
2330 sizeof(o->receive_signaling_method));
2331 ast_copy_string(o->transmit_signaling_method, resolved->transmit_method,
2332 sizeof(o->transmit_signaling_method));
2333 ast_copy_string(o->rxctcssfreqs, resolved->receive_ctcss, sizeof(o->rxctcssfreqs));
2334 ast_copy_string(o->txctcssfreqs, resolved->transmit_ctcss, sizeof(o->txctcssfreqs));
2335 ast_copy_string(o->txctcssdefault, resolved->transmit_ctcss_default,
2336 sizeof(o->txctcssdefault));
2337 ast_copy_string(o->dcs_receive_code, resolved->dcs_receive_code,
2338 sizeof(o->dcs_receive_code));
2339 ast_copy_string(o->dcs_transmit_code, resolved->dcs_transmit_code,
2340 sizeof(o->dcs_transmit_code));
2341 o->rxdemod = resolved->rxdemod;
2342 o->rxcdtype = resolved->rxcdtype;
2343 o->rxsdtype =
2344 !strcasecmp(resolved->receive_method, "ctcss") ? resolved->rxsdtype : SD_IGNORE;
2345 o->rxcpusaver = resolved->rxcpusaver;
2346 o->txcpusaver = resolved->txcpusaver;
2347 o->voxhangtime = resolved->voxhangtime;
2348 o->rxsqvoxadj = resolved->rxsqvoxadj;
2349 o->rxsqhyst = resolved->rxsqhyst;
2350 o->rxnoisefiltype = resolved->rxnoisefiltype;
2351 o->rxsquelchdelay = resolved->rxsquelchdelay;
2352 o->rxondelay = resolved->rxondelay;
2353 o->rxpolarity = resolved->rxpolarity;
2354 o->rxsquelchadj = resolved->rxsquelchadj;
2355 o->rxfreq = resolved->rxfreq;
2356 o->lsdrxpolarity = resolved->lsdrxpolarity;
2357 o->txpreemphasis = resolved->txpreemphasis;
2358 o->txsettletime = resolved->txsettletime;
2359 o->txrxblankingtime = resolved->txrxblankingtime;
2360 o->txoffdelay = resolved->txoffdelay;
2361 o->txpolarity = resolved->txpolarity;
2362 o->txfreq = resolved->txfreq;
2363 o->lsdtxpolarity = resolved->lsdtxpolarity;
2364 o->rxctcssadj = resolved->rxctcssadj;
2365 o->rxctcssoverride = resolved->rxctcssoverride;
2366 o->rxctcssrelax = resolved->rxctcssrelax;
2367 o->ctcss_level = resolved->ctcss_level;
2368 o->txtoctype = resolved->txtoctype;
2369 o->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees = resolved->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees;
2370 o->ctcss_tail_duration_ms = resolved->ctcss_tail_duration_ms;
2371 o->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz = resolved->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz;
2372 o->dcs_turnoff_enabled = resolved->dcs_turnoff_enabled;
2373 o->dcs_turnoff_duration_ms = resolved->dcs_turnoff_duration_ms;
2374 o->dcs_level = resolved->dcs_level;
2375}

2377int apply_processing_signaling_overrides(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const char *category)
2378{
2379 struct processing_signaling_values resolved;
2380
2381 if (!o || resolve_processing_signaling(category, &resolved))
2382 return -1;
2383 /* Commit only after every value has been parsed and cross-validated. This
2384 * keeps a rejected reload from partially changing live receiver signaling. */
2385 commit_processing_signaling(o, &resolved);
2386 return 0;
2387}
2388
2389int usbradioplus_refresh_all_processing_signaling(void)
2390{
2391 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel;
2392
2393 /* Resolve every profile before touching any live radio. The candidate
2394 * settings snapshot is immutable during reload, so a second pass cannot
2395 * introduce a semantic failure after an earlier channel has committed. */
2396 for (channel = usbradioplus_channel_first(); channel; channel = channel->next) {
2397 struct processing_signaling_values resolved;
2398
2399 if (channel->radio && resolve_processing_signaling(channel->name, &resolved))
2400 return -1;
2401 }
2402 for (channel = usbradioplus_channel_first(); channel; channel = channel->next) {
2403 struct processing_signaling_values resolved;
2404 int result;
2405
2406 /* Configured-but-uninitialized entries have no audio reader or parser
2407 * state yet; store_config() resolves them before creating the engine. */
2408 if (!channel->radio)
2409 continue;
2410 /* The complete candidate was preflighted above. Keep this defensive
2411 * check in case a caller replaces the settings source concurrently. */
2412 if (resolve_processing_signaling(channel->name, &resolved))
2413 return -1;
2414 radio_access_begin_reconfigure(channel);
2415 commit_processing_signaling(channel, &resolved);
2416 result = radio_config_locked(channel);
2417 radio_access_end_reconfigure(channel);
2418 if (result)
2419 return -1;
2420 }
2421 return 0;
2422}
2423
2424int apply_processing_config_overrides(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const char *category)
2425{
2426 struct usbradioplus_hardware_settings hardware;
2427 char value[512];
2428 char option[64];
2429 char *end;
2430 int i;
2431 long number;
2432 size_t option_index;
2433 size_t tone_count;
2434 static const int parallel_pins[] = {2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12, 13, 15};
2435 static const char *const asterisk_jitter_options[] = {
2436 "jbenable", "jbmaxsize", "jbresyncthreshold", "jbimpl",
2437 "jblog", "jbforce", "jbtargetextra", "jbsyncvideo",
2438 };
2439 static const char *const modern_jitter_options[] = {
2440 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_enabled",
2441 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_max_size_ms",
2442 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_resync_threshold_ms",
2443 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_implementation",
2444 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_logging_enabled",
2445 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_force_enabled",
2446 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_target_extra_ms",
2447 "asterisk_jitter_buffer_video_sync_enabled",
2448 };
2449
2450#define GET(section, name) \
2451 (!usbradioplus_processing_get_option(category, (section), (name), value, sizeof(value)))
2452
2453#define INTEGER(section, name, field) \
2454 do { \
2455 if (GET((section), (name))) { \
2456 number = strtol(value, &end, 0); \
2457 if (end == value || *end) \
2458 goto invalid; \
2459 o->field = number; \
2460 } \
2461 } while (0)
2462
2463#define BOOLEAN(section, name, field) \
2464 do { \
2465 if (GET((section), (name))) { \
2466 if (!ast_true(value) && !ast_false(value)) \
2467 goto invalid; \
2468 o->field = ast_true(value); \
2469 } \
2470 } while (0)
2471
2472#define STRING(section, name, field) \
2473 do { \
2474 if (GET((section), (name))) \
2475 ast_copy_string(o->field, value, sizeof(o->field)); \
2476 } while (0)
2477
2478 /* Typed hardware settings include inherited flat-section defaults. Mirror
2479 * values needed by channel initialization before creating the signaling
2480 * engine; live mixer levels continue to use the typed accessors directly. */
2481 if (usbradioplus_processing_get_hardware(category, &hardware))
2482 goto invalid;
2483 o->txmixa = (enum radio_tx_mix)hardware.output_a_assignment;
2484 o->txmixb = (enum radio_tx_mix)hardware.output_b_assignment;
2485 o->rxcdtype = effective_rxcdtype(o);
2486 STRING("ctcss", "receive_frequencies", rxctcssfreqs);
2487 STRING("ctcss", "transmit_frequencies", txctcssfreqs);
2488 /* The processing parser rejects every malformed CTCSS value, including
2489 * inactive-direction controls. Keep the direct override path equally strict
2490 * so live reload and unit callers cannot preserve an invalid latent value. */
2491 if ((!ast_strlen_zero(o->rxctcssfreqs) &&
2492 !ctcss_frequency_list_valid(o->rxctcssfreqs, &tone_count)) ||
2493 (!ast_strlen_zero(o->txctcssfreqs) &&
2494 !ctcss_frequency_list_valid(o->txctcssfreqs, &tone_count)))
2495 goto invalid;
2496
2497 STRING("hardware", "hardware_device_identifier", devstr);
2498 STRING("hardware", "hardware_serial", serial);
2499 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_interface_type", hdwtype);
2500 BOOLEAN("hardware", "hardware_eeprom_enabled", wanteeprom);
2501 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_audio_fragment_count", frags);
2502 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_audio_queue_size", queuesize);
2503 BOOLEAN("receive", "cpu_saver_enabled", rxcpusaver);
2504 BOOLEAN("transmit", "cpu_saver_enabled", txcpusaver);
2505 STRING("receive", "signaling_method", receive_signaling_method);
2506 STRING("transmit", "signaling_method", transmit_signaling_method);
2507 if (GET("receive", "cos_assignment"))
2508 o->rxcdtype = carrier_detect_from_assignment(value);
2509 if (GET("receive", "audio_source"))
2510 store_rxdemod(o, value);
2511 if (GET("ctcss", "receive_source"))
2512 store_rxsdtype(o, value);
2513 INTEGER("receive", "vox_hang_ms", voxhangtime);
2514 INTEGER("receive", "vox_threshold", rxsqvoxadj);
2515 INTEGER("receive", "noise_squelch_hysteresis", rxsqhyst);
2516 INTEGER("receive", "noise_filter_type", rxnoisefiltype);
2517 INTEGER("receive", "squelch_delay_ms", rxsquelchdelay);
2518 INTEGER("receive", "on_delay_frames", rxondelay);
2519 if (o->rxondelay > MS_TO_FRAMES(RX_ON_DELAY_MAX))
2520 o->rxondelay = MS_TO_FRAMES(RX_ON_DELAY_MAX);
2521 BOOLEAN("receive", "polarity_inverted", rxpolarity);
2522 INTEGER("receive", "squelch_level", rxsquelchadj);
2523 if (GET("ctcss", "receive_decoder_gain_db")) {
2524 double adjustment = strtod(value, &end);
2525 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(adjustment))
2526 goto invalid;
2527 o->rxctcssadj = pow(10.0, adjustment / 20.0);
2528 }
2529 BOOLEAN("ctcss", "receive_override_enabled", rxctcssoverride);
2530 INTEGER("ctcss", "receive_relax", rxctcssrelax);
2531 STRING("ctcss", "transmit_default_hz", txctcssdefault);
2532 if (!ast_strlen_zero(o->txctcssdefault) && !ctcss_frequency_valid(o->txctcssdefault))
2533 goto invalid;
2534 if (GET("ctcss", "transmit_peak_dbfs")) {
2535 double peak = strtod(value, &end);
2536 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(peak) || peak < -90.0 || peak > 0.0)
2537 goto invalid;
2538 o->ctcss_level = 32767.0 * pow(10.0, peak / 20.0);
2539 }
2540 if (GET("ctcss", "turnoff_mode"))
2541 store_txtoctype(o, value);
2542 if (GET("ctcss", "phase_shift_degrees")) {
2543 o->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees = strtod(value, &end);
2544 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(o->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees) ||
2545 o->ctcss_phase_shift_degrees <= 0.0)
2546 goto invalid;
2547 }
2548 if (GET("ctcss", "tail_duration_ms")) {
2549 number = strtol(value, &end, 0);
2550 /* Match the two-frame tail setup and signed 16-bit signaling timer. */
2551 if (end == value || *end || number < 2L * MS_PER_FRAME || number > INT16_MAX)
2552 goto invalid;
2553 o->ctcss_tail_duration_ms = number;
2554 }
2555 if (GET("ctcss", "tail_frequency_hz")) {
2556 o->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz = strtod(value, &end);
2557 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(o->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz) ||
2558 o->ctcss_tail_frequency_hz <= 0.0)
2559 goto invalid;
2560 }
2561 STRING("dcs", "receive_code", dcs_receive_code);
2562 STRING("dcs", "transmit_code", dcs_transmit_code);
2563 /* Preserve valid inactive DCS settings for a later mode change, but reject
2564 * malformed syntax now instead of silently treating it as carrier mode. */
2565 if ((!ast_strlen_zero(o->dcs_receive_code) && !dcs_code_valid(o->dcs_receive_code)) ||
2566 (!ast_strlen_zero(o->dcs_transmit_code) && !dcs_code_valid(o->dcs_transmit_code)))
2567 goto invalid;
2568 BOOLEAN("dcs", "turnoff_code_enabled", dcs_turnoff_enabled);
2569 if (GET("dcs", "turnoff_duration_ms")) {
2570 number = strtol(value, &end, 0);
2571 if (end == value || *end || number < 150 || number > 200)
2572 goto invalid;
2573 o->dcs_turnoff_duration_ms = number;
2574 }
2575 if (GET("dcs", "peak_dbfs")) {
2576 o->dcs_level = strtod(value, &end);
2577 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(o->dcs_level) || o->dcs_level < -90.0 ||
2578 o->dcs_level > 0.0)
2579 goto invalid;
2580 o->dcs_level = 32767.0 * pow(10.0, o->dcs_level / 20.0);
2581 }
2582 /* A direction has one active signaling system. Keep its configured CTCSS and
2583 * DCS data intact, however: receive and transmit are independent directions,
2584 * and radio_config() selects the active sources without destroying a valid
2585 * inactive-direction setting. */
2586 if (ast_strlen_zero(o->receive_signaling_method))
2587 ast_copy_string(o->receive_signaling_method, "carrier",
2588 sizeof(o->receive_signaling_method));
2589 if (ast_strlen_zero(o->transmit_signaling_method))
2590 ast_copy_string(o->transmit_signaling_method, "carrier",
2591 sizeof(o->transmit_signaling_method));
2592 if (!strcasecmp(o->receive_signaling_method, "carrier")) {
2593 store_rxsdtype(o, "no");
2594 } else if (!strcasecmp(o->receive_signaling_method, "ctcss")) {
2595 if (o->rxsdtype == SD_IGNORE) {
2596 signaling_configuration_error(category,
2597 "CTCSS receive_source must not be no");
2598 goto invalid;
2599 }
2600 if (!ctcss_frequency_list_valid(o->rxctcssfreqs, NULL)) {
2601 signaling_configuration_error(
2602 category,
2603 "receive signaling_method=ctcss requires supported [ctcss] "
2604 "receive_frequencies");
2605 goto invalid;
2606 }
2607 if (!strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "ctcss") &&
2608 !ctcss_frequency_lists_mapped(o->rxctcssfreqs, o->txctcssfreqs)) {
2609 signaling_configuration_error(
2610 category,
2611 "CTCSS receive-to-transmit operation requires equal-length "
2612 "[ctcss] receive_frequencies and transmit_frequencies "
2613 "lists of supported tones");
2614 goto invalid;
2615 }
2616 } else if (!strcasecmp(o->receive_signaling_method, "dcs")) {
2617 store_rxsdtype(o, "no");
2618 if (!dcs_code_valid(o->dcs_receive_code)) {
2619 signaling_configuration_error(
2620 category,
2621 "receive signaling_method=dcs requires a valid [dcs] receive_code");
2622 goto invalid;
2623 }
2624 } else {
2625 goto invalid;
2626 }
2627 if (!strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "carrier")) {
2628 } else if (!strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "ctcss")) {
2629 if (!ctcss_frequency_valid(o->txctcssdefault)) {
2630 signaling_configuration_error(category,
2631 "CTCSS transmit_default_hz is not supported");
2632 goto invalid;
2633 }
2634 } else if (!strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "dcs")) {
2635 if (!dcs_code_valid(o->dcs_transmit_code)) {
2636 signaling_configuration_error(category, "DCS transmit_code is invalid");
2637 goto invalid;
2638 }
2639 } else {
2640 goto invalid;
2641 }
2642 /* This control is a CTCSS decoder bypass, not a generic receive bypass.
2643 * Inactive CTCSS settings must not accidentally qualify DCS or carrier RX. */
2644 if (strcasecmp(o->receive_signaling_method, "ctcss"))
2645 o->rxctcssoverride = 0;
2646 if ((!strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "ctcss") ||
2647 !strcasecmp(o->transmit_signaling_method, "dcs")) &&
2648 !urp_tx_pair_has_tone((enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixa,
2649 (enum urp_tx_output_mode)o->txmixb)) {
2650 signaling_configuration_error(category,
2651 "transmit signaling requires [hardware] output A or "
2652 "B to carry ctcss or voice_ctcss");
2653 goto invalid;
2654 }
2655 BOOLEAN("receive", "lsd_polarity_inverted", lsdrxpolarity);
2656 BOOLEAN("transmit", "lsd_polarity_inverted", lsdtxpolarity);
2657 BOOLEAN("transmit", "preemphasis_enabled", txpreemphasis);
2658 INTEGER("transmit", "settle_ms", txsettletime);
2659 INTEGER("transmit", "rx_blanking_ms", txrxblankingtime);
2660 INTEGER("transmit", "off_delay_frames", txoffdelay);
2661 if (o->txoffdelay > MS_TO_FRAMES(TX_OFF_DELAY_MAX))
2662 o->txoffdelay = MS_TO_FRAMES(TX_OFF_DELAY_MAX);
2663 BOOLEAN("transmit", "polarity_inverted", txpolarity);
2664 BOOLEAN("hardware", "hardware_ptt_inverted", invertptt);
2665 INTEGER("receive", "frequency_hz", rxfreq);
2666 INTEGER("transmit", "frequency_hz", txfreq);
2667 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_repeater_number", rptnum);
2668 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_area", area);
2669 STRING("hardware", "hardware_user_key", ukey);
2670 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_idle_interval", idleinterval);
2671 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_turnoff_count", turnoffs);
2672 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_voter_reporting", sendvoter);
2673 INTEGER("hardware", "hardware_clip_led_gpio", clipledgpio);
2674 for (i = 0; i < GPIO_PINCOUNT; ++i) {
2675 snprintf(option, sizeof(option), "hardware_gpio_%d_mode", i + 1);
2676 if (GET("hardware", option)) {
2677 ast_free(o->gpios[i]);
2678 o->gpios[i] = ast_strdup(value);
2679 if (!o->gpios[i])
2680 goto invalid;
2681 }
2682 }
2683 for (option_index = 0; option_index < ARRAY_LEN(parallel_pins); ++option_index) {
2684 int pin = parallel_pins[option_index];
2685 snprintf(option, sizeof(option), "hardware_parallel_pin_%d_assignment", pin);
2686 if (GET("hardware", option)) {
2687 ast_free(o->pps[pin]);
2688 o->pps[pin] = ast_strdup(value);
2689 if (!o->pps[pin])
2690 goto invalid;
2691 haspp = 1;
2692 }
2693 }
2694 INTEGER("duplex", "duplex_radio_mode", radioduplex);
2695 INTEGER("duplex", "duplex_local_repeat_level", duplex3);
2696 if (GET("duplex", "duplex_local_repeat_mode")) {
2697 if (!strcasecmp(value, "hardware"))
2698 o->duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_HARDWARE;
2699 else if (!strcasecmp(value, "software"))
2700 o->duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE;
2701 else
2702 goto invalid;
2703 }
2704 if (GET("hardware", "hardware_deemphasis_corner_hz")) {
2705 double frequency = strtod(value, &end);
2706 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(frequency))
2707 goto invalid;
2708 o->plus_deemphasis_corner_hz = frequency;
2709 }
2710 if (GET("hardware", "hardware_preemphasis_corner_hz")) {
2711 double frequency = strtod(value, &end);
2712 if (end == value || *end || !isfinite(frequency))
2713 goto invalid;
2714 o->plus_preemphasis_corner_hz = frequency;
2715 }
2716 BOOLEAN("general", "channel_enabled", radioactive);
2717 INTEGER("diagnostics", "diagnostics_trace_type", tracetype);
2718 INTEGER("diagnostics", "diagnostics_trace_level", tracelevel);
2719 INTEGER("diagnostics", "diagnostics_fever", fever);
2720 for (option_index = 0; option_index < ARRAY_LEN(asterisk_jitter_options); ++option_index)
2721 if (GET("asterisk", modern_jitter_options[option_index]) &&
2722 ast_jb_read_conf(&global_jbconf, asterisk_jitter_options[option_index], value))
2723 goto invalid;
2724#undef STRING
2725#undef BOOLEAN
2726#undef INTEGER
2727#undef GET
2728 return 0;
2729invalid:
2730 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: invalid processing configuration override\n", category);
2731#undef STRING
2732#undef BOOLEAN
2733#undef INTEGER
2734#undef GET
2735 return -1;
2736}
