2738int save_tuning_config(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
2739{
2740 static const char *const demodulation[] = {"no", "speaker", "flat"};
2741 static const char *const assignments[] = {"off", "voice", "ctcss", "voice_ctcss",
2742 "auxvoice"};
2743 struct usbradioplus_config_update updates[24];
2744 enum urp_ctcss_source configured_ctcss_source;
2745 char ctcss_receive_source[64];
2746 char values[24][64];
2747 size_t count = 0;
2748
2749#define ADD_TEXT(group, key, text) \
2750 do { \
2751 updates[count] = (struct usbradioplus_config_update){(group), (key), (text)}; \
2752 ++count; \
2753 } while (0)
2754
2755#define ADD_NUMBER(group, key, format, number) \
2756 do { \
2757 snprintf(values[count], sizeof(values[count]), (format), (number)); \
2758 ADD_TEXT((group), (key), values[count]); \
2759 } while (0)
2760 /* rxsdtype is intentionally SD_IGNORE unless CTCSS is the active receive
2761 * method. Persist the profile setting instead, so changing away from CTCSS
2762 * for a while cannot erase its configured indication source on a tune save. */
2763 ast_copy_string(ctcss_receive_source, sd_signal_type[o->rxsdtype],
2764 sizeof(ctcss_receive_source));
2765 if (!usbradioplus_processing_get_option(o->name, "ctcss", "receive_source",
2766 ctcss_receive_source,
2767 sizeof(ctcss_receive_source)) &&
2768 urp_parse_ctcss_source(ctcss_receive_source, &configured_ctcss_source))
2769 ast_copy_string(ctcss_receive_source, sd_signal_type[o->rxsdtype],
2770 sizeof(ctcss_receive_source));
2771 if (!ast_strlen_zero(o->devstr))
2772 ADD_TEXT("hardware", "hardware_device_identifier", o->devstr);
2773 if (!ast_strlen_zero(o->serial))
2774 ADD_TEXT("hardware", "hardware_serial", o->serial);
2775 ADD_NUMBER("hardware", "hardware_input_gain_db", "%.3f",
2776 urp_mixer_to_gain_db(effective_rxmixerset(o)));
2777 ADD_NUMBER("hardware", "hardware_output_a_gain_db", "%.3f",
2778 urp_mixer_to_gain_db(effective_txmixaset(o)));
2779 ADD_NUMBER("hardware", "hardware_output_b_gain_db", "%.3f",
2780 urp_mixer_to_gain_db(effective_txmixbset(o)));
2781 ADD_NUMBER("ctcss", "receive_decoder_gain_db", "%.3f",
2782 20.0 * log10(fmax(o->rxctcssadj, 1.0e-6)));
2783 ADD_NUMBER("ctcss", "transmit_peak_dbfs", "%.3f",
2784 20.0 * log10(fmax(o->ctcss_level / 32767.0, 1.0e-6)));
2785 ADD_NUMBER("receive", "squelch_level", "%d", o->rxsquelchadj);
2786 ADD_TEXT("receive", "cos_assignment", cd_signal_type[o->rxcdtype]);
2787 ADD_TEXT("ctcss", "receive_source", ctcss_receive_source);
2788 ADD_NUMBER("receive", "on_delay_frames", "%d", o->rxondelay);
2789 ADD_NUMBER("transmit", "off_delay_frames", "%d", o->txoffdelay);
2790 ADD_TEXT("transmit", "preemphasis_enabled", o->txpreemphasis ? "yes" : "no");
2791 ADD_TEXT("receive", "audio_source", demodulation[o->rxdemod]);
2792 ADD_TEXT("hardware", "hardware_output_a_assignment", assignments[o->txmixa]);
2793 ADD_TEXT("hardware", "hardware_output_b_assignment", assignments[o->txmixb]);
2794 ADD_NUMBER("diagnostics", "diagnostics_fever", "%d", o->fever);
2795 ADD_NUMBER("duplex", "duplex_local_repeat_level", "%d", o->duplex3);
2796 ADD_TEXT("duplex", "duplex_local_repeat_mode",
2797 o->duplex3mode == DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE ? "software" : "hardware");
2798 ADD_NUMBER("local", "input_gain_db", "%.3f", effective_rx_input_gain_db(o));
2799#undef ADD_NUMBER
2800#undef ADD_TEXT
2801 return usbradioplus_processing_save_options(o->name, updates, count);
2802}

2827static void native_receive_filter_config(const struct txagc_chain *chain,

2829{

2845static int native_ctcss_code_frequency(const char *frequencies, int code, double *result_frequency)
2846{
2847 const char *cursor = frequencies;
2848
2849 if (!cursor || !result_frequency || code < 0 || code >= CTCSS_NUM_CODES)
2850 return 0;
2851 while (*cursor) {
2852 char *end;
2853 double parsed_frequency = strtod(cursor, &end);
2854
2855 if (end == cursor)
2856 return 0;
2857 if (urp_ctcss_frequency_index((float)parsed_frequency) == code) {
2858 *result_frequency = parsed_frequency;
2859 return 1;
2860 }
2861 cursor = end;
2862 while (*cursor == ' ' || *cursor == '\t')
2863 ++cursor;
2864 if (*cursor != ',')
2865 return 0;
2866 ++cursor;
2867 while (*cursor == ' ' || *cursor == '\t')
2868 ++cursor;
2869 }
2870 return 0;
2871}

2873#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
2874int usbradioplus_test_native_ctcss_code_frequency(const char *frequencies, int code,
2875 double *frequency)
2876{
2877 return native_ctcss_code_frequency(frequencies, code, frequency);
2878}

2886static void native_receive_notch_config(const struct txagc_chain *chain, double frequency,
2887 struct txagc_config *config)
2888{
2889 /* The base slot has already applied the receive band-pass. This slot must
2890 * add only the decoded tone's notch; repeating the band-pass here changes
2891 * its response and makes a decoded-tone transition audible. */
2892 memset(config, 0, sizeof(*config));
2893 config->ctcss_filter_mode = TXAGC_CTCSS_FILTER_NOTCH;
2894 config->ctcss_notch_width_hz = chain->agc.ctcss_notch_width_hz;
2895 snprintf(config->ctcss_notch_frequencies, sizeof(config->ctcss_notch_frequencies), "%.1f",
2896 frequency);
2897}

2903static void native_local_dynamics_config(const struct txagc_chain *chain,
2904 struct txagc_config *config)
2905{
2906 *config = chain->agc;
2907 config->input_gain_db = 0.0;
2908 /* De-emphasis and PL filtering are fixed native graphs before RNNoise and
2909 * the optional graph, so the dynamics graph must not reproduce either one. */
2910 config->deemphasis_enabled = 0;
2911 config->ctcss_filter_mode = TXAGC_CTCSS_FILTER_DISABLED;
2912 config->receive_bandpass_enabled = 0;
2913}

2920static void native_final_config(const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, const struct txagc_chain *chain,
2921 struct txagc_config *config)
2922{
2923 *config = chain->agc;
2924 /* The source master gates only optional reorderable stages. */
2925 if (!chain->enabled) {
2926 config->agc_enabled = 0;
2927 config->expander_enabled = 0;
2928 config->compressor_enabled = 0;
2929 config->limiter_enabled = 0;
2930 }
2931 config->preemphasis_enabled = o->txpreemphasis;
2932 config->emphasis_corner_hz = o->plus_preemphasis_corner_hz;
2933 config->emphasis_reference_hz = 1000.0;
2934 /* Voice/telemetry spectral shaping belongs to the configured processing
2935 * graph. The DCS-only shaper is built separately below. */
2936 config->dcs_spectral_shaping_enabled = 0;
2937 config->dcs_spectral_lowpass_hz = 0.0;
2938}

2943static void native_graph_set_destroy(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *graphs)
2944{
2945 int code;
2946
2947 if (!graphs)
2948 return;
2949 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->receive_deemphasis);
2950 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->receive_filter);
2951 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->local_dynamics);
2952 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->final);
2953 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->dcs);
2954 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->dcs_turnoff);
2955 for (code = 0; code < CTCSS_NUM_CODES; ++code)
2956 txagc_avfilter_destroy(&graphs->ctcss_notch[code]);
2957 ast_free(graphs);
2958}

2963static void native_graph_set_init(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *graphs)
2964{
2965 int code;
2966
2967 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->receive_deemphasis);
2968 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->receive_filter);
2969 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->local_dynamics);
2970 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->final);
2971 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->dcs);
2972 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->dcs_turnoff);
2973 for (code = 0; code < CTCSS_NUM_CODES; ++code)
2974 txagc_avfilter_init(&graphs->ctcss_notch[code]);

2980static void native_graph_slot_lock(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot)
2981{
2982 while (atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_acquire)) {
2983 sched_yield();
2984#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
2985 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_release);
2986#endif
2987 }
2988}

2993static void native_graph_slot_unlock(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot)
2994{
2995 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_release);
2996}
2997
3001static void native_graph_slot_init(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot)
3002{
3003 memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
3004 atomic_init(&slot->active, NULL);
3005 atomic_init(&slot->readers, 0U);
3006 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&slot->writer, memory_order_relaxed);
3007}
3008
3012static void native_graph_slot_destroy(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot)
3013{
3014 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *graphs;
3015
3016 native_graph_slot_lock(slot);
3017 atomic_store_explicit(&slot->active, NULL, memory_order_seq_cst);
3018 while (atomic_load_explicit(&slot->readers, memory_order_seq_cst) != 0U) {
3019 sched_yield();
3020#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
3021 atomic_store_explicit(&slot->readers, 0U, memory_order_seq_cst);
3022#endif
3023 }
3024 graphs = slot->owned;
3025 slot->owned = NULL;
3026 native_graph_slot_unlock(slot);
3027 while (graphs) {
3028 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *next = graphs->next_retired;
3029 native_graph_set_destroy(graphs);
3030 graphs = next;
3031 }
3032}
3033
3034#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
3035int usbradioplus_test_native_graph_slot_contention_paths(void)
3036{
3037 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot slot;
3038
3039 native_graph_slot_init(&slot);
3040 atomic_flag_test_and_set_explicit(&slot.writer, memory_order_relaxed);
3041 native_graph_slot_lock(&slot);
3042 native_graph_slot_unlock(&slot);
3043 atomic_store_explicit(&slot.readers, 1U, memory_order_seq_cst);
3044 native_graph_slot_destroy(&slot);
3045 return (int)atomic_load_explicit(&slot.readers, memory_order_seq_cst);
3046}
3047#endif
3048
3059static int native_graph_slot_preflight(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot)
3060{
3061 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *retired = NULL;
3062
3063 native_graph_slot_lock(slot);
3064 if (slot->owned && slot->owned->next_retired) {
3065 if (atomic_load_explicit(&slot->readers, memory_order_seq_cst) != 0U) {
3066 native_graph_slot_unlock(slot);
3067 return -1;
3068 }
3069 retired = slot->owned->next_retired;
3070 slot->owned->next_retired = NULL;
3071 }
3072 native_graph_slot_unlock(slot);
3073 while (retired) {
3074 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *next = retired->next_retired;
3075 native_graph_set_destroy(retired);
3076 retired = next;
3077 }
3078 return 0;
3079}
3080
3094static void native_graph_slot_publish(struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot,
3095 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *graphs)
3096{
3097 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *retired = NULL;
3098
3099 native_graph_slot_lock(slot);
3100 graphs->next_retired = slot->owned;
3101 slot->owned = graphs;
3102 atomic_store_explicit(&slot->active, graphs, memory_order_seq_cst);
3103 if (atomic_load_explicit(&slot->readers, memory_order_seq_cst) == 0U) {
3104 retired = graphs->next_retired;
3105 graphs->next_retired = NULL;
3106 }
3107 native_graph_slot_unlock(slot);
3108 while (retired) {
3109 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *next = retired->next_retired;
3110 native_graph_set_destroy(retired);
3111 retired = next;
3112 }
3113}
3114
3115struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *
3116usbradioplus_native_graphs_acquire(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
3117{
3118 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_slot *slot;
3119 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *graphs;
3120
3121 if (!channel)
3122 return NULL;
3123 slot = &channel->plus_native_graphs;
3124 /* Pair sequentially-consistent operations with publication's active-store
3125 * followed by reader-count load. The global order either pins the old graph
3126 * before its publisher observes readers, or makes this load observe the new
3127 * active graph after publisher saw zero. */
3128 atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&slot->readers, 1U, memory_order_seq_cst);
3129 graphs = atomic_load_explicit(&slot->active, memory_order_seq_cst);
3130 if (!graphs)
3131 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&slot->readers, 1U, memory_order_seq_cst);
3132 return graphs;
3133}
3134
3135void usbradioplus_native_graphs_release(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel)
3136{
3137 if (channel)
3138 atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&channel->plus_native_graphs.readers, 1U,
3139 memory_order_seq_cst);
3140}
3141
3147static int native_graph_set_build(const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o,
3148 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set **graphs)
3149{
3150 static const struct txagc_config dcs_shaping_config = {
3151 .dcs_spectral_shaping_enabled = 1,
3152 .dcs_spectral_lowpass_hz = 250.0,
3153 /* The steep 250-Hz spectral filter has +3.41 dB passband gain at the
3154 * DCS/EOT fundamentals. Normalize that fixed response so dcs_peak_dbfs
3155 * remains the requested transmitter peak without a general limiter. */
3156 .output_gain_db = -3.42,
3157 };
3158 static const struct txagc_config dcs_turnoff_shaping_config = {
3159 .dcs_spectral_shaping_enabled = 1,
3160 .dcs_spectral_lowpass_hz = 250.0,
3161 /* The 134.4-Hz sine does not have the NRZ waveform's +3.41 dB
3162 * shaped passband rise. Keep its independently calibrated peak at
3163 * dcs_peak_dbfs without putting a limiter in the signaling path. */
3164 .output_gain_db = 0.0,
3165 };
3166 struct txagc_chain local;
3167 struct txagc_chain composite;
3168 struct txagc_config receive_deemphasis;
3169 struct txagc_config receive_filter;
3170 struct txagc_config local_dynamics;
3171 struct txagc_config final;
3172 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *candidate;
3173 int code;
3174
3175 if (!o || !o->name || !graphs || usbradioplus_processing_get_local(o->name, &local) ||
3176 usbradioplus_processing_get_composite(o->name, &composite))
3177 return -1;
3178 native_receive_deemphasis_config(o, &receive_deemphasis);
3179 native_receive_filter_config(&local, &receive_filter);
3180 native_local_dynamics_config(&local, &local_dynamics);
3181 native_final_config(o, &composite, &final);
3182 candidate = ast_calloc(1, sizeof(*candidate));
3183 if (!candidate)
3184 return -1;
3185 native_graph_set_init(candidate);
3186 /* Native ticks consume this generation as one immutable transaction. Keep
3187 * the few non-FFmpeg local controls beside their prepared graphs so a reload
3188 * cannot combine a new setting snapshot with an older graph generation. */
3189 candidate->app_rpt_rate = o->plus_app_rpt_rate;
3190 candidate->app_rpt_samples = o->plus_app_rpt_samples;
3191 candidate->program_target_samples = o->plus_program_target_samples;
3192 candidate->legacy_interface = !o->plus_advanced;
3193 candidate->receive_cpu_saver = o->rxcpusaver;
3194 candidate->noise_squelch_gate = o->radio && o->radio->rxCdType == CD_XPMR_NOISE;
3195 candidate->receive_squelch_delay_samples =
3196 o->rxsquelchdelay ? (size_t)o->rxsquelchdelay * (URP_RATE_NATIVE / 1000U) : 0U;
3197 candidate->echo_mode = o->echomode;
3198 candidate->software_repeat_enabled =
3199 o->duplex3 > 0 && o->duplex3mode == DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE;
3200 candidate->software_repeat_gain = (double)o->duplex3 / DUPLEX3_LEVEL_MAX;
3201 candidate->local_chain_enabled = local.enabled;
3202 candidate->local_rnnoise_enabled = local.rnnoise_enabled;
3203 /* Gain conversion is configuration work. The native callback only applies
3204 * this immutable multiplier sample by sample and never evaluates pow(). */
3205 candidate->local_input_gain_linear = pow(10.0, local.agc.input_gain_db / 20.0);
3206 if (txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->receive_deemphasis, &receive_deemphasis,
3207 URP_RATE_NATIVE) < 0 ||
3208 txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->receive_filter, &receive_filter, URP_RATE_NATIVE) <
3209 0 ||
3210 txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->local_dynamics, &local_dynamics, URP_RATE_NATIVE) <
3211 0 ||
3212 txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->final, &final, URP_RATE_NATIVE) < 0 ||
3213 txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->dcs, &dcs_shaping_config, URP_RATE_NATIVE) < 0 ||
3214 txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->dcs_turnoff, &dcs_turnoff_shaping_config,
3215 URP_RATE_NATIVE) < 0)
3216 goto failed;
3217 if (receive_filter.ctcss_filter_mode == TXAGC_CTCSS_FILTER_NOTCH) {
3218 for (code = 0; code < CTCSS_NUM_CODES; ++code) {
3219 struct txagc_config notch;
3220 double frequency;
3221
3222 if (!native_ctcss_code_frequency(o->rxctcssfreqs, code, &frequency))
3223 continue;
3224 native_receive_notch_config(&local, frequency, &notch);
3225 if (txagc_avfilter_prepare(&candidate->ctcss_notch[code], &notch,
3226 URP_RATE_NATIVE) < 0)
3227 goto failed;
3228 }
3229 }
3230 *graphs = candidate;
3231 return 0;
3232
3233failed:
3234 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: unable to prepare native FFmpeg processing\n", o->name);
3235 native_graph_set_destroy(candidate);
3236 return -1;
3237}

3239#ifdef URP_PROCESSING_TESTING
3240int usbradioplus_test_native_graph_set_build(const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel,
3241 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set **graphs)
3242{
3243 return native_graph_set_build(channel, graphs);
3244}
3245#endif

3247int usbradioplus_prepare_native_processing(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
3248{
3249 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *candidate;
3250
3251 if (native_graph_set_build(o, &candidate))
3252 return -1;
3253 if (native_graph_slot_preflight(&o->plus_native_graphs)) {
3254 native_graph_set_destroy(candidate);
3255 return -1;
3256 }
3257 /* The callback acquires this one pointer for its whole 20-ms block. A bad
3258 * candidate therefore leaves every old stage active rather than creating a
3259 * transient mixture of generations. */
3260 native_graph_slot_publish(&o->plus_native_graphs, candidate);
3261 return 0;
3262}
3263
3265struct native_graph_plan {
3267 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel;
3269 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_set *graphs;
3270};
3271
3273struct usbradioplus_native_graph_transaction {
3275 struct native_graph_plan *plans;
3277 size_t count;
3278};
3279
3280/* Destroy a native graph transaction that was not published. The public
3281 * declaration carries the API documentation without duplicating it here. */
3282void usbradioplus_discard_native_processing_transaction(
3283 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_transaction *transaction)
3284{
3285 size_t index;
3286
3287 if (!transaction)
3288 return;
3289 for (index = 0; index < transaction->count; ++index)
3290 native_graph_set_destroy(transaction->plans[index].graphs);
3291 ast_free(transaction->plans);
3292 ast_free(transaction);
3293}
3294
3295/* Build and preflight every native graph without publishing a generation. */
3296int usbradioplus_stage_all_native_processing(
3297 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_transaction **transaction)
3298{
3299 struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel;
3300 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_transaction *candidate;
3301 size_t count = 0;
3302 size_t index = 0;
3303
3304 if (!transaction)
3305 return -1;
3306 *transaction = NULL;
3307 for (channel = usbradioplus_channel_first(); channel; channel = channel->next)
3308 if (channel->plus_dsp_initialized)
3309 ++count;
3310 candidate = ast_calloc(1, sizeof(*candidate));
3311 if (!candidate)
3312 return -1;
3313 if (!count) {
3314 *transaction = candidate;
3315 return 0;
3316 }
3317 candidate->plans = ast_calloc(count, sizeof(*candidate->plans));
3318 if (!candidate->plans) {
3319 ast_free(candidate);
3320 return -1;
3321 }
3322 /* Build every replacement first. A failed later graph must never leave an
3323 * earlier channel on new settings while the rest retain the old generation. */
3324 for (channel = usbradioplus_channel_first(); channel; channel = channel->next) {
3325 if (!channel->plus_dsp_initialized)
3326 continue;
3327 candidate->plans[index].channel = channel;
3328 if (native_graph_set_build(channel, &candidate->plans[index].graphs)) {
3329 candidate->count = index;
3330 usbradioplus_discard_native_processing_transaction(candidate);
3331 return -1;
3332 }
3333 ++index;
3334 }
3335 candidate->count = count;
3336 for (index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
3337 if (native_graph_slot_preflight(
3338 &candidate->plans[index].channel->plus_native_graphs)) {
3339 usbradioplus_discard_native_processing_transaction(candidate);
3340 return -1;
3341 }
3342 }
3343 *transaction = candidate;
3344 return 0;
3345}
3346
3347/* Publish an already staged all-channel native graph transaction. Publication
3348 * has no fallible work: all allocation and slot preflight happens
3349 * in usbradioplus_stage_all_native_processing(). Each callback therefore sees
3350 * either its former immutable generation or its complete replacement. */
3351void usbradioplus_publish_native_processing_transaction(
3352 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_transaction *transaction)
3353{
3354 size_t index;
3355
3356 if (!transaction)
3357 return;
3358 for (index = 0; index < transaction->count; ++index) {
3359 native_graph_slot_publish(&transaction->plans[index].channel->plus_native_graphs,
3360 transaction->plans[index].graphs);
3361 transaction->plans[index].graphs = NULL;
3362 }
3363 usbradioplus_discard_native_processing_transaction(transaction);
3364}
3365
3366int usbradioplus_prepare_all_native_processing(void)
3367{
3368 struct usbradioplus_native_graph_transaction *transaction;
3369
3370 if (usbradioplus_stage_all_native_processing(&transaction))
3371 return -1;
3372 usbradioplus_publish_native_processing_transaction(transaction);
3373 return 0;
3374}

3376int usbradioplus_dsp_init(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
3377{
3378 o->plus_dsp_initialized = 0;
3379 if (rpcr_init(&o->plus_program_ring, URP_PROGRAM_RING_SAMPLES, RPCR_SINC_BEST) ||
3380 rpcr_set_rates(&o->plus_program_ring, URP_APP_RPT_RATE_DEFAULT, URP_RATE_NATIVE)) {
3381 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: unable to create native program ring\n", o->name);
3382 return -1;
3383 }
3384 native_graph_slot_init(&o->plus_native_graphs);
3385 /* A CTCSS/DCS parser reload can replace decoder-owned memory. Initialize
3386 * this separate gate before the hardware callback can enter a native tick. */
3387 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_access.readers, 0U);
3388 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_access.reconfiguring, 0);
3389 atomic_flag_clear_explicit(&o->plus_radio_access.writer, memory_order_relaxed);
3390 usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_reset(o);
3391 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_tx_active, 0);
3392 atomic_init(&o->plus_hardware_ptt_request, 0);
3393 atomic_init(&o->plus_hardware_ptt_applied, 0);
3394 atomic_init(&o->plus_hardware_online, 0);
3395 atomic_init(&o->plus_hardware_inputs, 0U);
3396 atomic_init(&o->plus_clip_led_request, 0);
3397 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_program_generation, 0U);
3398 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_program_rx_frequency, 0U);
3399 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_program_tx_frequency, 0U);
3400 atomic_init(&o->plus_radio_program_high_power, 0);
3401 atomic_init(&o->txkeyed, 0);
3402 atomic_init(&o->txtestkey, 0);
3403 /* The HID/setup thread replaces this baseline before starting device I/O.
3404 * Initializing it here lets an early native tick safely render the legacy
3405 * routing instead of touching an uninitialized atomic object. */
3406 atomic_init(&o->plus_applied_txmixa, o->txmixa);
3407 atomic_init(&o->plus_applied_txmixb, o->txmixb);
3408 atomic_init(&o->plus_applied_tx_output_gain_a, M_Q8);
3409 atomic_init(&o->plus_applied_tx_output_gain_b, M_Q8);
3410 atomic_init(&o->plus_hardware_generation, 0U);
3411 atomic_init(&o->plus_test_tone_enabled, 0);
3412 o->plus_adc_peak_dbfs = o->plus_adc_max_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3413 o->plus_deemphasis_peak_dbfs = o->plus_deemphasis_max_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3414 o->plus_preemphasis_input_peak_dbfs = o->plus_preemphasis_input_max_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3415 o->plus_tx_program_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3416 o->plus_tx_program_max_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3417 o->plus_local_tx_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3418 o->plus_local_tx_max_peak_dbfs = -INFINITY;
3419 if (usbradioplus_prepare_native_processing(o)) {
3420 native_graph_slot_destroy(&o->plus_native_graphs);
3421 rpcr_destroy(&o->plus_program_ring);
3422 return -1;
3423 }
3424 o->plus_dsp_initialized = 1;
3425 if (usbradioplus_native_renderer_start(o)) {
3426 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "RadioPlus/%s: unable to create native audio renderer\n",
3427 o->name);
3428 o->plus_dsp_initialized = 0;
3429 native_graph_slot_destroy(&o->plus_native_graphs);
3430 rpcr_destroy(&o->plus_program_ring);
3431 return -1;
3432 }
3433 return 0;
3434}

3436void usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
3437{
3438 /* Callers quiesce their hardware callback before retiring renderer-owned
3439 * graphs, SRC state, RNNoise state, and echo storage. */
3440 usbradioplus_tx_playout_hold_reset(o);
3441 usbradioplus_native_renderer_stop(o);
3442 o->plus_dsp_initialized = 0;
3443 rpcr_destroy(&o->plus_program_ring);
3444 native_graph_slot_destroy(&o->plus_native_graphs);
3445 ast_free(o->plus_parrot);
3446 o->plus_parrot = NULL;
3447 o->plus_parrot_capacity = o->plus_parrot_count = o->plus_parrot_play = 0;
3448}

3487void usbradioplus_refresh_ctcss_decode(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)

3506int usbradioplus_ensure_parrot_capacity(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o)
3507{
3508 size_t capacity = (size_t)DEFAULT_ECHO_MAX * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES;
3509 double *buffer;
3510
3511 if (!o)
3512 return -1;
3513 /* The direct renderer preallocates native echo storage before the callback
3514 * can render. Never reallocate fallback storage while it is active. */
3515 if (o->plus_native_renderer)
3516 return 0;
3517 if (o->plus_parrot_capacity >= capacity && o->plus_parrot)
3518 return 0;
3519 buffer = ast_realloc(o->plus_parrot, capacity * sizeof(*buffer));
3520 if (!buffer)
3521 return -1;
3522 o->plus_parrot = buffer;
3523 o->plus_parrot_capacity = capacity;
3524 return 0;
3525}

3527void usbradioplus_parrot_rx_transition(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *o, int was_keyed)
3528{
3529 /* The direct callback detects native echo transitions from its per-frame
3530 * snapshot. This fallback must not mutate callback-owned recording state. */
3531 if (!o || o->plus_native_renderer)
3532 return;
3533 if (urp_parrot_rx_transition(&o->plus_parrot_state, was_keyed, o->rxkeyed))
3534 atomic_store_explicit(&o->echoing, 1, memory_order_release);
3535}

3537/* Distinguish named radio channels from flat and scoped settings sections.
3538 * @param section Configuration section name.
3539 * @return Nonzero when the stated condition holds; zero otherwise.
3540 */
3541int usbradioplus_is_radio_channel_section(const char *section)
3542{
3543 static const char *const reserved[] = {
3544 "general", "asterisk", "hardware", "receive", "transmit", "ctcss",
3545 "dcs", "duplex", "diagnostics", "local", "link", "voice_telemetry"};
3546 size_t i;
3547
3548 if (!section || strchr(section, ' '))
3549 return 0;
3550 for (i = 0; i < ARRAY_LEN(reserved); ++i)
3551 if (!strcasecmp(section, reserved[i]))
3552 return 0;
3553 return 1;
3554}
3555
3556int load_config(int reload)
3557{
3558 struct ast_config *cfg = NULL;
3559 char *ctg = NULL;
3560 const char *val;
3561 char processing_value[64];
3562 struct ast_flags zeroflag = {reload ? CONFIG_FLAG_FILEUNCHANGED : 0};
3563
3564 /* load config file */
3565 cfg = ast_config_load(CONFIG, zeroflag);
3566 if (!cfg) {
3567 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "Unable to load config %s.\n", CONFIG);
3568 return AST_MODULE_LOAD_DECLINE;
3569 } else if (cfg == CONFIG_STATUS_FILEUNCHANGED) {
3570 ast_log(LOG_NOTICE, "Config file %s unchanged, skipping.\n", CONFIG);
3571 return 0;
3572 } else if (cfg == CONFIG_STATUS_FILEINVALID) {
3573 ast_log(LOG_ERROR, "Config file %s is in an invalid format. Aborting.\n", CONFIG);
3574 return -1;
3575 }
3576
3577 /* store the configuration */
3578 store_config(NULL);
3579 while ((ctg = ast_category_browse(cfg, ctg)) != NULL) {
3580 /* Scoped profile sections supply settings; only bare section names
3581 * instantiate RadioPlus channels. */
3582 if (usbradioplus_is_radio_channel_section(ctg))
3583 store_config(ctg);
3584 }
3585
3586 /* load parallel port information */
3587 ppfd = -1;
3588 pbase = 0;
3589 if (usbradio_active && !usbradioplus_processing_get_option(
3590 usbradio_active, "hardware", "hardware_parallel_port_device",
3591 processing_value, sizeof(processing_value)))
3592 val = processing_value;
3593 else
3594 val = NULL;
3595 if (val) {
3596 ast_copy_string(pport, val, sizeof(pport));
3597 } else {
3598 ast_copy_string(pport, PP_PORT, sizeof(pport));
3599 }
3600 if (usbradio_active &&
3601 !usbradioplus_processing_get_option(usbradio_active, "hardware",
3602 "hardware_parallel_port_base_address",
3603 processing_value, sizeof(processing_value)))
3604 val = processing_value;
3605 else
3606 val = NULL;
3607 if (val) {
3608 pbase = strtoul(val, NULL, 0);
3609 }
3610 if (!pbase) {
3611 pbase = PP_IOPORT;
3612 }
3613 ast_radio_load_parallel_port(&haspp, &ppfd, &pbase, pport, reload);
3614 ast_config_destroy(cfg);
3615 return 0;
3616}
3617
3618int reload_module(void)
3619{
3620 int result = usbradioplus_processing_reload();
3621 if (!result)
3622 result = load_config(1);
3623 /* load_config resolves the channel-side signaling and emphasis fields. Build
3624 * one complete native generation only after those values are final; a failed
3625 * candidate leaves the prior generation active in the audio callback. */
3626 if (!result)
3627 result = usbradioplus_prepare_all_native_processing();
3628 if (!result)
3629 (void)usbradioplus_refresh_all_processing_hardware();
3630 return result;
3631}
